Crawl Quick-Start Guide
=======================

Copyright 1999 Linley Henzell


So, you want to start playing Crawl straight away without bothering with the
manual? Read this, the guide to starting Crawl with a minimum of preparation.

I suggest printing it out and following its instructions while playing your
first few games (you can also press `?` twice while playing for a list of
commands). You should also try the tutorial mode; it only takes a few
minutes.

When you get some more time, you can read `crawl_manual.txt` in the docs/
directory for more detailed information.

INTRODUCTION TO CRAWL
---------------------

Crawl is a large and very random game of subterranean exploration in a fantasy
world of magic and frequent violence. Your quest is to travel into the depths
of the Dungeon (which is different each time you play) and retrieve the Orb of
Zot.

Crawl is an RPG of the `rogue-like` type, one of the descendants of Rogue. Its
graphics are simple but highly informative, designed to be understood at a
glance, and control is exercised largely through one-keystroke commands.

STARTING OUT
------------

After starting the program you will be greeted with a message asking for your
name. Don't spend too much time over this, as your first character will **not**
last very long (sorry, but it's true).

Next you are given menus of species and backgrounds from which to choose.
A mountain dwarf, minotaur or troll Fighter is a good bet. Elves are quite
fragile, humans are pretty average at everything, and the weirder species are
mostly too tricky for beginning players. Finally, you may be given a choice of
weapons. I suggest an axe (axes are fun).

Now you are in the game. The game screen has three parts:

 - the Map takes up the upper left part of the screen. In its very centre is
   the `@` sign (or player doll tile) which represents You. The bright parts of
   the Map are the parts you can see, while places which you have visited
   before but cannot currently see are darkened.
 - the Message box is the large part of the screen below the map. It describes
   events as they happen and asks you questions from time to time.
 - the Stats area (to the right of the Map) contains various indicators of
   your health and abilities.

EXPLORING
---------

Try walking around, using either the numeric keypad (try numlock off and on) or
the Rogue (`hjklyubn`) keys. Pressing `o` will activate auto-explore, which will
move until an enemy is seen, or some other notable event (e.g. finding a set of
stairs) occurs.

If you want to know what a certain character on the screen represents, you can
use the `x` (examine) command to get a short description, and then `v` to get
more information. You use the `O`, `C` commands to open or close doors, and the
`<` (up) and `>` (down) commands to climb staircases.

The Dungeon gets more dangerous (but more interesting!) as you go down. If you
get lost you can access a map of the whole level you are on with the `X`
command, which uses the whole screen.

ITEMS
-----

After walking around for a while, you will no doubt come across some items
lying around (you may come across some monsters as well; for help in dealing
with them skip to the Monsters section). You can pick up items with the `g`
(get) or `,` commands and drop them again with `d` (drop), and the `i`
(inventory) command shows you what you're carrying. While examining your
inventory, press any item's key to see more information about it, and to list
available commands.

There are several different types of items:

 - **Weapons**, represented by the `)` sign. Wield them with the `w` (wield)
   command.
 - **Armour** (`[`). Wear it, or take it off, with the `W` (Wear) command.
   Heavier armours give more protection, but may hamper your ability to dodge,
   cast spells, or fire ranged weapons.
 - **Ammunition** (which has the `(` sign). Throw it with `f` and `F` (fire).
 - **Wands** (`/`), **Scrolls** (`?`) and **Potions** (`!`) can be very
   valuable, but have limited uses (scrolls and potions can only be used once
   each, wands contain only a certain number of charges). Wands are e`V`oked,
   scrolls are `r`ead and potions are `q`uaffed. Unfortunately, you won't at
   first know what a scroll or potion does; it will only be described by its
   physical appearance. But once you have used, for example, a potion of curing,
   you will in the future recognise all potions of curing.
 - **Rings** (`=`) and **Amulets** (`"`) provide various mostly-helpful effects.
   They are put on with `P` (put on) and can be removed with `R`.
 - **Money** (`$`) can be used to buy stuff in shops.

There are a few other types of items, but you will discover these as you play.

MONSTERS
--------

You will also run into monsters (most of which are represented by letters of
the alphabet). You can attack a monster by trying to move into the square it
is occupying. Pressing Tab will automatically move toward & attack nearby
monsters.

When you are wounded you lose hit points (displayed near the top of the stats
list); these return gradually over time through the natural process of
healing. If you lose all of your hp you die.

To survive, you will need to develop a few basic tactics:

 - Rest between encounters. The `s`, `.`, delete or keypad-5 commands make you
   rest for one turn, while pressing `5` or Shift-and-keypad-5 make you rest
   for a longer time (you will stop resting when fully healed).
 - Never fight more than one monster if you can help it. Always back into a
   corridor so that they must fight you one-on-one.
 - Consumable items like scrolls and potions won't do you any good when you're
   dead, and most are more effective when used at the start of a tough fight
   than when you're near death. Try identifying some ahead of time by 'wasting'
   one from a stack while in a safe spot.
 - Remember to use projectiles before engaging monsters in close combat.
 - Learn when to run away from things you can't handle - this is important!
   It is often wise to skip a dangerous level. But don't overdo this.

DEATH
-----

Before long, you'll probably end up dead.

Death in Crawl is permanent; you cannot just reload a saved game and start
again where you left off. The `S` (save) command exists only to let you leave
a game part-way through and come back to it later. Quitting (`Ctrl-Q`) lets
you abandon a character if you can't even be bothered to help them escape alive.

Well, that's it for the quick-start guide. This should help you through your
first few games, but Crawl is extremely (some would say excessively) complex
and cannot be adequately described in so short a document. So when you feel
ready to start playing with magic, skills, and religions, browse the manual.

Happy Crawling!

Macros and Keymaps
==================

What are macros and keymaps? The simple explanation is:

Command macros make keys into commands.
Keymaps make keys into other keys.

Or a bit more verbose:

For the most part, people will probably want command macros. They allow
for things like making a key run a sequence of commands (e.g.
associating a key stroke to the casting of a certain spell) without
having to worry about messing up what that key does at prompts (e.g.
you can macro a number or letter without worrying about it making the
substitution when you're trying to drop an item).

Keymaps are for when you want to fix layout and behavioural problems on
your keyboard (i.e. unrecognised numpad sequences can by mapped into
their numbers, foreign keyboard layouts can be modified to be more
comfortable). There are also special sets of keymaps for the level map,
the targeting mode and confirmation prompts, which allow for mappings
that are restricted to just those situations.


How to create macros and keymaps?
=================================

The simplest way is in-game: Press either the '~' key or Ctrl-D, select
'm' to define a macro, then choose a key to assign for your macro and
enter the command sequence. For some keys (or key combinations), Crawl
will display a strange number (for example \{13} for the Return key).
These numbers are the key codes for certain non-alphanumeric keys and
can vary between different systems.

By default, most upper- and lowercase alphanumeric keys are already
assigned functions in Crawl. While you are free to remap those keys as
well, it might be best to start with some of the currently unused keys,
such as Ins or the function keys (F1 to F12), possibly combined with
Ctrl, Shift or both. On some systems, it may also be possible to
incorporate the Alt (Meta) key.

Defining keymaps works in exactly the same way. Just press 'k'
(default), 'x' (level-map), 't' (targeting) or 'c' (confirmation)
instead of 'm' after pressing '~'.

After defining such a macro or keymap, you should test it. If you are
comfortable with it, you should then save the macro. To save all macros
and keymaps, press '~' and then 's' to save macros at the tilde prompt).


The macro.txt file
==================

Macros and keymaps are stored in a file called macro.txt in your
settings/ directory. You can change where the file is read from and
written to by specifying a different directory with the macro_dir
option in your init file (see options_guide.txt for details). The
macro.txt file is human readable and editable, but you might have to
figure out the key codes for non-alphanumeric keys through in-game
experimentation or external utilities.

Lines beginning with the '#' are comments and will be ignored. Note
that Crawl won't necessarily preserve your comments when saving macros
and keymaps to the macro.txt file.

Each macro definition consists of exactly two lines. The first one
describes the macro trigger key and consists of "M:" followed by the
character or keycode of that key (for example 'a', 'A' or \{9} for
the A, Shift-A or Tab keys). The second one describes the macro action
and consists of "A:" followed by the command sequence to be associated
with the above key (for example "zap" for zapping the spell in slot a
at the previous target). Individual macro definitions should be
separated by empty lines.

For keymaps just replace the "M:" on the first line of the definition
with one of the following:
"K:"  default,
"K1:" level-map,
"K2:" targeting or
"K3:" confirmation.


Examples
========

This section contains some examples to give you an idea what macros and
keymaps can be used for. Note that for the sake of completeness, both
key line and command line are given, but that you should probably
substitute your own keys here as these may not always work for you.


'@' is a character that may not work by default on some keyboard
layouts. The following should remedy that by mapping '@' to '@'.

# @: display character status
K:\{17}
A:@


Playing a summoner can be annoying because you often need to cast the
same spells multiple times in a row, each casting requiring multiple
keystrokes. This macro allows casting the spell in slot 'a' with a
single keystroke. Note that you can redefine spell slots with the '='
key. We emphasise again that the F1 key may get a different code on
your system.

# F1: cast spell 'a'
M:\{368}
A:za


Now that we've taken care of summoning, we still need to command our
summoned creatures. The following macro should make that easier as
well. Note that this macro assumes that the default_target option is
set to true (it is by default; see crawl_options.txt for details).

# Tab: Order allies to attack your previous or the nearest target
M:\{9}
A:ta.


Conjurers need a slightly different macros for casting, such as this
one, as they need to press '.' or Return to confirm firing at a target.
Again, this macro assumes that the default_target option is set to
true.

# F1: cast spell 'a' at your previous or the nearest target
M:\{368}
A:za.


However, even conjurers might not always want to fire at their previous
target, so the following set of macros allows them to cast the spell
in slot 'a' and then cycle through the available targets with the same
key and then confirming with the same key we used for firing in the
previous macro. This example also tries to illustrate how to take
advantage of the fact that keys can have different functions in the
different keymaps.

# Shift-F1: cast spell 'a'
M:\{1392}
A:za

# Shift-F1: cycle through targets when in targeting mode
K2:\{1392}
A:+

# F1: fire at target when in targeting mode
K2:\{368}
A:.

Tiles specific commands
-----------------------

There are several different ways to interact with your environment, both
by typing the command keys, and by using the mouse.

Of notable interest is the clickable tab area to the right of the screen
that allows easy access to e.g. inventory, spells, or common commands.

Depending on your screen resolution, one of more of these panels may be
open at any time, though you can temporarily exchange the inventory view
with another type of tiled panel by clicking on the tab icons.

You can customize the priority of the control panels by modifying the
tile_layout_priority option in init.txt in the settings directory.


Movement
--------

You can move by using the arrow keys, the vi-keys, or the number pad.
(For the latter try both Numlock on and off.)

Numpad:   7 8 9     vi-keys:   y k u
           \|/                  \|/
          4-.-6                h-.-l
           /|\                  /|\
          1 2 3                b j n


To run several steps into the same direction, press Shift along with these
keys.

You can also move by clicking somewhere on the map or minimap with your
mouse. If the square is reachable from your current position and there are
no hostile monsters in sight, you will automatically travel there. If there
are hostile monsters in sight, you will only take a single step at a time.

For automatic exploration, you can either type the 'o' command or you can
click on the corresponding tile in the command panel to the right of your
screen. Like mouseclick travel, these will refuse to work if there are
hostile monsters in sight.


Getting information
-------------------

Doing a right-click with your mouse on any feature, monster or item on the
main map or in the tiled control panels will display the description of
said feature, monster or item on a separate screen.

A simple mouseover will usually display the same description, or as much of
it as can fit, in the message area.

Similarly, letting your mouse rest for a while on a feature, monster or
item will usually display a "tool tip" of applicable commands.


Attacking monsters
------------------

You can attack a monster in melee by moving into it with the movement keys
or by clicking on it with your mouse.

For ranged attacks (including spells and wands), mouse over the monsters
and wait for the tool tip to appear. Alternatively, you can cast spells by
clicking on the spell tiles in the spell panel, or fire ammunition or
evoke wands by clicking on them in the inventory panel.

In the command panel, you'll also find a tile described as "Autofight",
which, if clicked, will attack an adjacent monster in melee, or if there is
no adjacent monster, take one step in the direction of the closest monster.


Item usage
----------

The easiest way to use items is by clicking on them in the inventory panel.
The mouseover tool tip will tell you what a mouseclick will do, and also
the corresponding command key to execute the same action.
As an alternative, you can also use an item by selecting it in the inventory
('i' command) and then pressing the appropriate key in the action prompt.

To pick up items on the ground, you can either click on them one by one in
the floor section of the inventory panel, or you can click on the player
tile and pull up a menu of selectable items instead. In the latter case,
'Enter' will confirm your selection and start pick up.

Dropping items works similarly, either by clicking on single items in the
inventory panel, or by typing the 'd' command and then selecting items
from a menu.


Interacting with the dungeon
----------------------------

Again, doing a mouseover on features (such as staircases or doors) in the
main map will tell you how to interact with them.


Character status
----------------

Doing a right-click on the player tile will display a character overview
screen listing equipment, resistances and stats.

More detailed screens on specific aspects of your characters can be
accessed by clicking on the corresponding tiles in the command panel.


Character appearance
--------------------

You can change your character's appearance with the Doll Editor, accessed with
the '-' command. Use 'm' to switch between modes: Equip, where your appearance
dynamically updates based on the items you equip; Default, a sprite based on
your character’s race and background; and Custom, which allows you to fully
customize each part of your character's look. Use the number keys to switch
between custom doll slots and the arrow keys to modify the different parts of
each custom sprite. Save your changes and selection with 'Ctrl-S'.



If you are experiencing significant slowdown and lags...
--------------------------------------------------------

Crawl renders its graphics using OpenGL and SDL. However, it needs hardware
acceleration to not run slowly. If you are on Windows, make sure to update
your graphics card driver. If you are on Linux, be sure that you are using
DRI.

It has been tested successfully with cards as old as the i865. Unfortunately,
it has been known to be slow on the i810 and there is little to be done in
that case but to run the console version instead or switch to a different
machine.

You can try tweaking a number of options in init.txt in the settings
directory to see whether performance improves:

travel_delay = -1
    This setting suppresses redrawing until travelling is finished or
    interrupted.

tile_update_rate = 1000
    By default, the screen gets redrawn at least every 1000 milliseconds,
    more often if you take actions that change the display. You could try
    cranking up this value, though this may lead to updating taking too long.

tile_runrest_rate = 17
    While running and resting the screen is redrawn every 17 milliseconds.
    If Crawl is slow while running or resting, increase this number.

tile_tooltip_ms = 0
    Deactivating the tooltips means there's less stuff to draw every time.

clear_map = false
    Not having to redraw remembered monsters outside your line of sight
    takes some load off the redrawing routines.

tile_window_width   = 1024
tile_window_height  = 768
    The larger the map area the more cells there are to redraw each turn.
    If you've got a large display showing way more than the necessary 17x17
    grids of the map, you could try specifying a lower resolution.

You struggle to resist the curse of the Prune...
messages.translation: 你竭力抵抗普鲁恩的诅咒……

messages.english: The curse of the Prune has no hold on the dead.
messages.translation: 普鲁恩的诅咒无法束缚亡者。

messages.english: The curse of the Prune lifts from you.
messages.translation: 普鲁恩的诅咒从你身上消散了。

messages.english: A terrible, searing pain shoots up your arm!
messages.translation: 一阵可怕的灼痛沿着你的手臂窜上！

messages.english: You feel the exhaustion of battles past.
messages.translation: 你感到昔日战斗留下的疲惫。
你感到自己不再那么暴戾。
万变钉头锤闪耀着光芒。

messages.english: You sense an extremely unholy aura.
messages.translation: 你感到一股极为亵渎的气息。

messages.english: You hear a strange loud sound.
messages.translation: 你听到一声奇怪的巨响。

messages.english: A gate to Pandemonium opens briefly!
messages.translation: 一扇通往魔窟的大门短暂开启！

messages.english: Your confusion fades away as the thirst for blood takes over your mind.
messages.translation: 嗜血欲望占据了你的心智，混乱随之消退。

messages.english: Your thirst for blood fades away.
You feel an uncomfortable desire to slay dragons.
messages.translation: 你感到一股令人不安的屠龙欲望。

messages.english: You feel an overwhelming desire to slay dragons!
messages.translation: 强烈的屠龙欲望淹没了你！

messages.english: Time to lay down the shillelagh law.
messages.translation: 是时候用橡木棍主持公道了。

messages.english: You feel oddly protected from the elements.
messages.translation: 你莫名地感到自己受到元素防护。

messages.english: You no longer feel protected from the elements.
messages.translation: 你不再感到自己受到元素防护。

messages.english: The light fades from your surroundings.
messages.translation: 你周围的光线暗了下来。

messages.english: The light returns to your surroundings.

messages.translation: 你的身体痛苦地扭曲变形。

messages.english: Your limbs ache and wobble like jelly.
messages.translation: 你的四肢疼痛，像果冻般颤动。

messages.english: Your body is flooded with magical radiation.
messages.translation: 魔法辐射充斥着你的身体。

messages.english: The arc blade crackles to life.
messages.translation: 弧刃噼啪作响，苏醒过来。

messages.english: You hear the crackle of electricity.
messages.translation: 你听到了电流的噼啪声。

messages.english: You are filled with an inner flame.

messages.english: The scimitar bursts into red hot flame!

messages.english: You feel a darkness envelop your magic.

messages.english: The darkness slowly releases its grasp on your magic.

messages.english: You sense a greater flux of ambient magical fields.
messages.translation: 你感到周围的魔法场涌动得更加剧烈。

messages.english: The vines latch onto your body!
The vines fall away from your body!

messages.english: Your attunement to healing potions increases.
messages.translation: 你对治疗药剂的调谐增强了。

messages.english: Your attunement to healing potions decreases.
messages.translation: 你对治疗药剂的调谐减弱了。

messages.english: The engine shudders to a halt.

messages.english: The bodies of the dead rush to embrace you!

messages.english: Your shell of carrion and bone grows thicker.
messages.translation: 你的腐肉与白骨外壳变厚了。

messages.english: The air around you leaps into flame!

messages.english: Your ring of flames gutters out.

messages.english: You feel ready to stride towards your foes.

messages.english: The gloves are unable to connect with your magical essence.

messages.english: Aren't you a tasty little thing?
messages.translation: 你可真是个美味的小家伙，不是吗？

messages.english: We're going to have a lot of fun together.
messages.translation: 我们在一起会玩得很开心。

messages.english: Let's make your enemies cower, shall we?
messages.translation: 让你的敌人们发抖吧，怎么样？

messages.english: You scratch my back, I'll scratch yours... and I'm one HELL of a backscratcher.
messages.translation: 你帮我，我帮你……而我可是一位来自地狱的好帮手。

messages.english: Another aspirant of the Dark Ways? We shall bring them all to heel together!
messages.translation: 又一个黑暗之道的追寻者？我们将一同让众生臣服！

messages.english: At last, a scion truly worthy of my power.
messages.translation: 终于，一个真正配得上我力量的传人。

messages.english: Finally, someone more useful than... these people.
messages.translation: 终于来了个比……这群家伙更有用的人。

messages.english: I knew you could not resist the dark call for long.
messages.translation: 我就知道，你抵挡不了黑暗的呼唤太久。

messages.english: I shall forgive your past transgressions, as long as you remember your place this time.
messages.translation: 只要你这次记住自己的地位，我就原谅你过去的冒犯。

messages.english: I shall graciously assume that you are merely clumsy, not stupid.
messages.translation: 我会宽宏大量地认为，你只是笨手笨脚，而非愚蠢。

messages.english: Don't test my patience; I have made greater than you beg for death over less!
messages.translation: 别考验我的耐心；比你更强大的人，曾因更小的过错而向我乞求一死！

messages.english: You'll be back again, mark my words....
messages.translation: 你还会回来的，记住我的话……

messages.english: Dare you to relinquish me? You shall regret this insult!
messages.translation: 你竟敢舍弃我？你会为这番羞辱后悔的！

messages.english: How arrogant, to think that any shield could be mightier than the power of Zonguldrok!
messages.translation: 竟以为区区盾牌能胜过宗古多克的力量，何等狂妄！

messages.translation: 混沌电弧: 命中敌人时，偶尔会向附近生物释放混沌电弧。

messages.english: Prune:     It halves damage taken while paralysed, petrified or unconscious.
messages.translation: 普鲁恩: 在麻痹、石化或昏迷时，使受到的伤害减半。

messages.english: Envenom: If the wielder is skilled in Evocations, they can envenom those struck by it, dealing poison damage which bypasses armour.
messages.translation: 灌毒: 若持有者擅长唤发，可使命中的目标受到无视护甲的毒素伤害。

messages.english:
Radiate: It can be activated via the 'a'bility menu to radiate toxic energy, with effectiveness depending on Evocations skill.
Alch: It enhances your alchemy magic.
rPois∞: It grants immunity to poison.
messages.translation:
毒能辐射: 可通过能力菜单（a）发动毒能辐射，效果取决于唤发技能。
炼金: 增强你的炼金术。
毒免疫: 使你免疫毒素。

messages.english: Mindtap:  Whenever a successful spell causes magic to be channelled from it, it may also drain additional magic from other enemies in sight, with a chance increasing with spell level.
messages.translation: 汲念: 成功施法并从中引导魔力时，也可能从视野内的其他敌人身上吸取额外魔力；几率随法术等级提高。

messages.english: Megavamp:  It occasionally heals its wielder for the full amount of damage dealt when it wounds a living foe.
messages.translation: 强效吸血: 伤害活物时，偶尔会按造成伤害的全部数值治疗持有者。

messages.english: Curses:    It inflicts powerful necromantic curses on any living foe it strikes.
messages.translation: 诅咒: 对命中的活物施加强大的死灵诅咒。

messages.english: Torment:   It occasionally torments all nearby living foes when it strikes in combat.
messages.translation: 折磨: 近战命中时，偶尔会折磨附近所有活着的敌人。

messages.english: Hellfire:  It temporarily reduces the fire resistance of those it strikes.
messages.translation: 地狱火: 暂时降低命中目标的火焰抗性。

messages.english: +Damnation: It grants the ability to hurl damnation at the cost of health and magic, with strength depending on Evocations skill.
messages.translation: +天谴: 允许消耗生命与魔力投掷地狱火，强度取决于唤发技能。

messages.english: Hellfire Court: It may summon demons of flame and damnation when striking foes.
messages.translation: 地狱火宫廷: 命中敌人时，可能召唤掌控火焰与天谴的恶魔。

messages.english: Umbra:     It surrounds you with an aura of shadow, increasing your stealth and reducing the accuracy of all others within it.
messages.translation: 暗影光环: 使你笼罩在暗影气场中，增强你的潜行，并降低范围内其他所有生物的命中率。

messages.english: Evervamp:  It heals its wielder for a portion of the damage dealt every time it strikes a living foe.
messages.translation: 持续吸血: 每次命中活物时，都按造成伤害的一部分治疗持有者。

messages.english: Execute:   It may instantly slay those it strikes, especially weaker foes.
messages.translation: 处决: 可能瞬间杀死命中的目标，对较弱敌人尤其有效。

messages.english: Spectral:  When it strikes, its spirit leaps out and fights alongside the wielder.
messages.translation: 幽灵: 命中时，武器之灵会跃出，与持有者并肩作战。

messages.english: Zealotry:  Whenever the wielder enters a berserk rage, their allies are berserked alongside them.
messages.translation: 狂热: 持有者进入狂暴时，其盟友也会一同狂暴。

messages.english: Damnation: Any ammunition fired from it explodes in a burst of damnation on striking a foe, dealing damage which bypasses armour.
messages.translation: 天谴: 射出的弹药命中敌人时，会爆发天谴，造成无视护甲的伤害。

messages.english: Decimate: It inflicts additional damage proportional to its victim's maximum health.
messages.translation: 摧残: 按受害者生命上限的一定比例造成额外伤害。

messages.english: Halo:      It grants its wielder a halo, revealing invisible creatures and increasing accuracy against all within it other than the wielder.
messages.translation: 光环: 为持有者赋予光环，揭示隐形生物，并提高对范围内其他所有生物的命中率。

messages.english: Ele:       It enhances your fire, ice, earth and air magic. If skilled in Evocations, you can discharge powerful blasts of elemental energy when striking with it.
messages.translation: 元素: 增强你的火系、冰系、土系与气系魔法。若擅长唤发，还能在近战命中时释放强大的元素能量。

messages.english: Acc+∞:     It never misses its target.
messages.translation: 命中+∞: 永远不会射失目标。

messages.english: Slay Drac: It inflicts extra damage against dragons and draconians.
messages.translation: 屠龙: 对龙与龙人造成额外伤害。

messages.english: Stab:      It is more effective when stabbing unaware enemies, sometimes treating them as though they were completely helpless.
messages.translation: 背刺: 对毫无察觉的敌人发动背刺时更有效，有时会将其视为完全无力反抗。

messages.english: Mutate:    It occasionally inflicts wild transmutation effects on those it strikes, inflicting malmutation or extra damage, or polymorphing them into a new form.
messages.translation: 致变: 命中时，偶尔会对目标施加狂野的变形效果，造成恶性变异、额外伤害，或将其变为另一种形态。

messages.english: Deathbane: It inflicts significantly more damage against the undead.
messages.translation: 亡灵克星: 对亡灵造成显著增加的伤害。

messages.english: Curare:    It occasionally inflicts asphyxiating poison on those it strikes, dealing poison damage and causing slowness.
messages.translation: 箭毒: 偶尔使命中目标受到窒息性毒素侵袭，造成毒素伤害和迟缓。

messages.english: Disarm:    It may disarm weapon-wielding foes when striking them, dealing extra damage in the process.
messages.translation: 缴械: 命中持有武器的敌人时，可能将其缴械，并在此过程中造成额外伤害。

messages.english: Penet:     Any ammunition fired by it passes through the targets it hits, potentially hitting all targets in its path until it reaches maximum range.
messages.translation: 穿透: 射出的弹药会穿过命中的目标，可能沿途命中所有目标，直到达到最远射程。

messages.english: Quiet:      All noise in your surroundings is dampened.
messages.translation: 静谧: 减弱你周围的所有噪音。

messages.english: Bear:      Going berserk makes the wearer exceptionally tough, and they are slowed for a shorter time afterward.
messages.translation: 熊灵: 狂暴时使穿戴者格外坚韧，且随后迟缓的持续时间更短。

messages.english:
Detect:    It allows the wearer to sense nearby creatures.
Stab+:     It allows the wearer to make particularly effective stabbing attacks against helpless or unaware enemies with any melee weapon.
messages.translation:
探知: 允许穿戴者感知附近生物。
背刺+: 允许穿戴者使用任何近战武器，对无力反抗或毫无察觉的敌人发动格外有效的背刺。

messages.english: *Englaciate: It radiates cold, occasionally slowing all nearby creatures who are not resistant to cold.
messages.translation: *冰封: 散发寒气，偶尔使附近所有不具寒冷抗性的生物迟缓。

messages.english:
Flames:    It surrounds you with flame clouds.
rFlCloud:  It grants immunity to flame clouds.
messages.translation:
烈焰: 以火焰云雾环绕你。
抗火云: 使你免疫火焰云雾。

messages.english:
Brill:     It increases the power of your magical spells and halves their MP cost (rounding up).
Will-∞:    It reduces your willpower to zero.
messages.translation:
辉煌: 提高法术强度，并使魔力消耗减半（向上取整）。
意志-∞: 使你的意志降至零。

messages.english: Dragonpray: It occasionally summons a dragon when using Invocations with hostile monsters in sight. Chance is 10% + twice the piety cost of the ability used.
messages.translation: 祈龙: 视野内有敌对怪物时，使用祈祷能力偶尔会召唤一条龙。几率为 10% 加上所用能力虔诚消耗的两倍。

messages.english: Dark:      It shrouds the wearer in darkness, reducing the range at which they can see and be seen by others.
messages.translation: 黑暗: 以黑暗笼罩穿戴者，缩小其视野及被其他生物看见的距离。

messages.english: Riposte:   It allows the wearer to riposte with melee weapons, swiftly retaliating against missed or blocked melee attacks.
messages.translation: 还击: 允许穿戴者使用近战武器还击，在敌人的近战攻击落空或被抵挡后迅速反击。

messages.english: *Dazzle:   It may blind adjacent enemies who miss an attack against the wearer in melee combat.
messages.translation: *炫目: 相邻敌人的近战攻击落空时，可能使其失明。

messages.english: *Rats:     When the wearer is hurt, rats may emerge from it to assist them.
messages.translation: *鼠群: 穿戴者受伤时，可能有老鼠从中钻出提供援助。

messages.english: Loud:      It is deafeningly noisy when blocking attacks.
messages.translation: 喧闹: 抵挡攻击时，会发出震耳欲聋的噪声。

messages.english: Inacc:     It reduces the accuracy of your attacks and spells.
messages.translation: 失准: 降低你攻击和法术的命中率。

messages.english: Fury:      It extends the wearer's berserk rage when killing foes.
messages.translation: 狂怒: 杀死敌人时，会延长穿戴者的狂暴时间。

messages.english:
*Thunder:  It occasionally creates storm clouds above nearby enemies.
rCloud:    It grants its wearer immunity to clouds.
messages.translation:
*雷云: 偶尔在附近敌人上方制造风暴云。
抗云雾: 使穿戴者免疫云雾。

messages.english: Demonic:   It occasionally summons demons to assist the wielder when it strikes in combat.
messages.translation: 恶魔: 近战命中时，偶尔召唤恶魔协助持有者。

messages.english: Mesm:      Its wielder is mesmerised by any visible foes, and it cannot be unequipped while any foes are visible.
messages.translation: 魅惑: 任何可见的敌人都会使持有者着迷；只要视野内仍有敌人，就无法卸下它。

messages.english: Swift:     It allows the wearer to cover ground more swiftly.
messages.translation: 迅捷: 使穿戴者能更快地移动。

messages.english: Manifold Assault: It sometimes launches melee attacks against multiple visible enemies.
messages.translation: 多重突袭: 有时对多个可见敌人发动近战攻击。

messages.english: Shatter:   It releases a powerful concussive burst when it strikes, dealing extra damage to the target and all other creatures adjacent to them.
messages.translation: 震碎: 命中时释放强大的震荡冲击，对目标及其相邻的所有其他生物造成额外伤害。

messages.english: Avatar's Aegis: It grants the wearer a chance to resist fire, cold, poison, electricity, acid, and negative energy.
messages.translation: 化身神盾: 使穿戴者有机会抵御火焰、寒冷、毒素、电击、酸蚀及负能量。

messages.english: Ring+:   It enables you to equip an extra ring.
messages.translation: 戒指+: 允许额外装备一枚戒指。

messages.english: Discharge: It occasionally unleashes powerful arcs of lightning upon striking a foe. These may arc to other adjacent creatures (including the wielder, but dealing reduced damage to them) before grounding out.
messages.translation: 放电: 命中敌人时，偶尔释放强大的闪电电弧；电弧可能传导至其他相邻生物（包括持有者，但对其造成的伤害较低），之后才导入地面。

messages.english: Disrupt:   It unleashes wild and unpredictable magical effects upon striking a wizard or a creature with magical abilities.
messages.translation: 扰魔: 命中法师或具有魔法能力的生物时，释放狂野而难以预测的魔法效果。

messages.english: Silver:    It inflicts extra damage upon those it strikes, and deals substantially increased damage to chaotic, mutated and magically transformed beings.
messages.translation: 白银: 对命中目标造成额外伤害，对混沌、变异或魔法变形的生物造成的伤害大幅增加。

messages.english: Immolate:  It fills those it strikes with an explosive inner flame.
messages.translation: 心火: 使命中目标的体内燃起爆炸性的心火。

messages.english: rFlCloud:  It grants immunity to clouds of flame.
messages.translation: 抗火云: 使你免疫火焰云雾。

messages.english: Spellvamp: It heals its wielder for a portion of the damage dealt when they wound a living foe with it or with a spell, but its wielder's spells cost health as well as magical power.
messages.translation: 法术吸血: 用它或法术伤害活物时，会按造成伤害的一部分治疗持有者；但持有者施法时除了魔力，还要消耗生命。

messages.english: NoPotionHeal: Its wearer cannot be healed by potions.
messages.translation: 药水不疗伤: 穿戴者无法通过药水获得治疗。

messages.english: PotionHeal*2: Potions heal its wearer twice as much.
messages.translation: 药水治疗×2: 药水对穿戴者的治疗量加倍。

messages.english: Freezing Cloud: It occasionally leaves clouds of freezing vapour upon striking a foe, and grants immunity to clouds of freezing vapour.
messages.translation: 冰冻云雾: 命中敌人时，偶尔留下冰冻云雾，并使持有者免疫冰冻云雾。

messages.english: Omnireflect: It can block and reflect piercing ranged attacks and magical attacks against the wielder's willpower.
messages.translation: 全能反射: 可以抵挡并反射穿透性远程攻击，以及针对持有者意志的魔法攻击。

messages.english:
Freeze:    It freezes victims, dealing an additional one-quarter of any damage that pierces defenders' armour. It may also slow down cold-blooded creatures.
Rev:       It becomes more effective when it hits something. This effect fades over time.
messages.translation:
冻结: 冻伤目标，额外造成穿透护甲伤害的四分之一，还可能使冷血生物迟缓。
加速: 命中目标时会变得更有效；此效果随时间消退。

messages.english: Reach+:    It can reach especially far, and its reaching attacks ignore other creatures in the way.
messages.translation: 延伸+: 攻击距离格外远，且延伸攻击会忽略挡路的其他生物。

messages.english:
Battle: It summons a battlesphere in combat, with strength depending on Conjurations skill.
Destructive: It enhances your destructive magic, and weakens non-destructive magic.
messages.translation:
战斗: 在战斗中召唤作战球，强度取决于塑能系魔法技能。
毁灭: 增强你的毁灭性魔法，削弱非毁灭性魔法。

messages.english:
Corpsefed: It gathers nearby corpses to temporarily increase the armour it provides.
rMiasma:   It protects you from foul pestilence.
messages.translation:
食尸: 收集附近的尸体，暂时提高其提供的护甲值。
抗瘴气: 保护你免受污秽瘟疫侵害。

messages.english: Rampage+∞: When moving toward enemies, its wearer moves as far as possible, alerting their target en route.
messages.translation: 冲锋+∞: 向敌人移动时，穿戴者会尽可能接近目标，并在途中惊动目标。

messages.english:
Infuse+∞:  It empowers its wearer's blows with all of their magic.
VampMP:    Blows struck in melee replenish the wearer's magic.
messages.translation:
灌注+∞: 用持有者的全部魔力强化其攻击。
汲取魔力: 近战命中时补充持有者的魔力。

messages.english: *Dream:    It absorbs a single lethal wound into itself, holding its wearer just short of death and releasing dream-creatures to guard them.
messages.translation: *梦境: 吸收一次致命创伤，使穿戴者停留在死亡边缘，并释放梦境生物守护穿戴者。

messages.english: ID++:      It heals its wearer when they drink unknown potions, and restores their MP when they read unknown scrolls.
messages.translation: 鉴定++: 穿戴者饮用未知药水时恢复生命，阅读未知卷轴时恢复魔力。

messages.english: Coup de Grace: It may instantly kill foes which have little health.
messages.translation: 致命一击: 可能瞬间杀死生命值较低的敌人。

messages.english: Meekguard: It provides extra protection to wielders with little health.
messages.translation: 护弱: 为生命值较低的持有者提供额外保护。

messages.english: Anguish:   It makes its victims' attacks reflect back on them.
messages.translation: 痛楚: 使受害者的攻击反射回自身。

messages.english: Steadfast: It prevents involuntary movement, except for blinking, teleportation, or banishment.
messages.translation: 稳固: 阻止非自愿移动，但闪现、传送和放逐除外。

messages.english: Reach-Cleave: It can be evoked to extend its reach, and strikes at all foes within reach, dealing less damage to those not targeted.
messages.translation: 延伸横扫: 可发动以延长攻击距离，并攻击范围内的所有敌人；对非主目标造成的伤害较低。

messages.english: Poleaxe:   It uses either Axes or Polearms skill, whichever is higher.
messages.translation: 长柄斧: 使用斧或长柄武器技能中较高的一项。

messages.english:
Invo=14:   It sets your Invocations skill to 14.
Evo=0:    It sets your Evocations skill to 0.
messages.translation:
祈祷=14: 将你的祈祷技能设为 14。
唤发=0: 将你的唤发技能设为 0。

messages.english:
Slick:     Its wearer cannot be constricted, netted, webbed, or stopped by binding sigils.
Slippery:  Its wearer slips away from damaging melee attacks, pulling the attacker onward.
messages.translation:
滑溜: 穿戴者不会受到绞缠、投掷网、蛛网或束缚印记的限制。
滑移: 穿戴者会避开造成伤害的近战攻击，并牵引攻击者向前。

messages.english: Knockback: It sometimes drives back enemies it hits.
messages.translation: 击退: 有时击退命中的敌人。

messages.english: Valiant:   It becomes more powerful as more dangerous foes come into view.
messages.translation: 英勇: 视野中出现的敌人越危险，它就越强大。

messages.english: *Victory:  When the wearer kills a threatening monster, it has a chance to gain +1 AC, +1 Slay, and +1 Int, capping at +7. When the wearer uses a scroll or a potion with a hostile monster in sight, its bonuses reset to +0. Unequipping it also resets its bonuses to +0.
messages.translation: *胜利: 穿戴者杀死有威胁的怪物时，有机会获得 +1 护甲值、+1 杀伤和 +1 智力，最高各为 +7。视野中有敌对怪物时，穿戴者使用卷轴或药水会使加成重置为 +0；卸下它也会使加成重置为 +0。

messages.english: Shock:     When it blocks an attack, it may electrocute the attacker. This works even against foes who are a short distance away.
messages.translation: 电击: 抵挡攻击时，可能电击攻击者，即使对方距离稍远也有效。

messages.english: Backblast: When fired, it often launches its wielder backwards.
messages.translation: 后坐冲击: 发射时，经常将持有者向后击退。

messages.english:
Gadgeteer:   Your evocable items recharge 30% faster and wands have a 30% chance to not spend a charge.
Wandboost:   Your wands are more powerful.
messages.translation:
巧匠: 可发动道具的充能速度提高 30%，魔杖有 30% 几率不消耗充能。
魔杖强化: 你的魔杖更强大。

messages.english:
It massively reduces your stealth.
It interferes with translocations, delaying teleports.
Charlatan: It boosts your other skills by 20% of your base Evocations skill.
messages.translation:
大幅降低你的潜行。
干扰位移魔法，使传送延迟。
骗术: 按你的基础唤发技能的 20% 提高其他技能。

messages.english:
Inspire:   When you summon or create an ally, it gains Regeneration.
Amulet+:   You can equip an additional amulet.
messages.translation:
鼓舞: 召唤或创造盟友时，使其获得再生。
护符+: 允许额外装备一枚护符。

messages.english:
Reaping:   When you kill an enemy with your weapon, its spirit may be forced to fight for you.
Hat+:   You can equip an additional hat (on the skull).
messages.translation:
收割: 用武器杀死敌人时，其灵魂可能被迫为你作战。
帽子+: 可在头骨上额外装备一顶帽子。

messages.english:
Shroompunch:   The cloak sometimes lashes out at its wearer's enemies, inflicting confusion with its spores.
Gloves+:   Your cloak can equip an additional pair of gloves.
messages.translation:
真菌拳: 披风有时会猛击穿戴者的敌人，以孢子造成混乱。
手套+: 可为披风额外装备一副手套。

messages.english:
Majesty:   You are bathed in light that prevents you from turning invisible. Whenever you enter a new floor, you announce yourself to nearby enemies and refuse to leave the floor again for some time.
Ring++:   You can equip two additional rings.
messages.translation:
威仪: 光芒笼罩着你，使你无法隐身。每次进入新楼层，你都会向附近敌人宣告自己的到来，并在一段时间内拒绝离开该层。
戒指++: 允许额外装备两枚戒指。
真的要在%s附近发动净化之焰吗？%s
真的要对%s发动净化之焰吗？%s

messages.english: This attack would place you under penance!
messages.translation: 这次攻击会使你受到惩戒！

messages.english: %s appears from out of thin air!
messages.original_english: %s appears from out of thin air!

messages.english: %s appears from out of your range of vision.
messages.original_english: %s appears from out of your range of vision.

messages.translation: 流星索扭曲着缠住%s，将其束缚在原地！
messages.original_english: The bolas warps around %s and binds %s in place!

messages.english: You feel life coursing into your body%s
messages.translation: 你感到生命力涌入体内%s

messages.translation: 盛着眩晕药液的烧瓶碎裂，化为一团恶臭云雾！

messages.translation: 你听到了一只手的声音！

messages.translation: 此分支静得不自然，声音在这里传得更远。

messages.english: in the middle of a polar vortex
You often become slowed when damaged by fire.
messages.translation: 受到火焰伤害时，你经常会陷入缓慢状态。

messages.english: You often become weak and blind when damaged by cold.
messages.translation: 受到寒冷伤害时，你经常会虚弱并失明。

messages.english: You often become unable to move when damaged by electricity.
messages.translation: 受到电击伤害时，你经常会无法移动。

messages.english: Your slaying and spellpower are decreased in confined spaces.
messages.translation: 处于狭窄空间时，你的杀戮加成和法术强度降低。

messages.english: Your evasion is greatly reduced on turns you move or wait in place.
messages.translation: 在你移动或原地等待的回合中，你的闪避值大幅降低。

messages.english: You feel a strange sense of nostalgia.
messages.translation: 你感到一种奇怪的怀旧之情。

messages.english: You heal other nearby enemies whenever you kill a monster.
messages.translation: 每当你杀死一个怪物，就会治疗附近的其他敌人。

messages.english: Enemies in your sight sometimes split into clones of themselves.
messages.translation: 视野内的敌人有时会分裂出自身的复制体。

messages.english: You are less proficient with several skills.
messages.translation: 你的数项技能熟练程度降低。

messages.english: Enemies you spot sometimes become touched by paradox.
messages.translation: 你发现的敌人有时会受到悖论影响。

messages.english: Enemies you encounter may be immune to damage from range.
messages.translation: 你遇到的敌人可能免疫远距离造成的伤害。

messages.english: When enemies are summoned, they will appear beside you instead.
messages.translation: 敌人被召唤时，会改为出现在你身旁。

messages.english: When alone and injured, reapers sometimes come to claim you.
messages.translation: 独处且受伤时，收割者有时会前来索命。

messages.english:
Welcome to Hell!
Please enjoy your stay.
messages.translation:
欢迎来到地狱！
祝你住得愉快。

messages.english: An ancient malice corrodes your equipment.
messages.translation: 古老的恶意腐蚀着你的装备。

messages.english: Your scrolls appear blurry in the acrid smoke.
messages.translation: 刺鼻的烟雾中，你的卷轴显得模糊不清。

messages.english: Your potions freeze solid in the terrible cold.
messages.translation: 酷寒使你的药水冻成了坚冰。

messages.english: This decaying realm drains your will.
messages.translation: 这个衰败的领域消磨着你的意志。

messages.english:
Welcome to the Realm of Zot!
You feel the power of the Orb interfering with translocations here.
messages.translation:
欢迎来到佐特领域！
你感到宝珠的力量正干扰着此地的位移魔法。

messages.english:
You enter the halls of Pandemonium!
To return, you must find a gate leading back.
messages.translation:
你进入了魔窟的殿堂！
若想返回，必须找到一扇通向来处的门。

messages.english: You land on top of a ziggurat so tall you cannot make out the ground.
messages.translation: 你落在一座高耸神塔的顶端，高得连地面都看不清。
你进入了一座跨维度市集！
你进入了一间巫师实验室！

messages.english: You enter a great desolation of salt!
messages.translation: 你进入了辽阔的荒盐之地！
你进入了奥格瓦如的竞技场！

messages.english: You are dragged down into the Crucible of Flesh!

messages.translation: 你进入了一座华丽的亡者之城！
费了一些力气才抵抗住。
几乎毫不费力地抵抗了。

messages.english: You feel firmly anchored in space.
messages.translation: 你感到自己被牢牢锚定在空间中。

messages.english: You feel more firmly anchored in space.
messages.translation: 你感到自己被更牢固地锚定在空间中。
你感到自己的魔法受到了污染。
你感到自己的魔法受到的污染更深了。

messages.english: The rain has left you waist-deep in water!

messages.translation: 诱变能量涌入你的体内。

messages.translation: 朝敌人移动时它使你额外前进一步；若因此发起攻击，则会使敌人短暂眩晕。

messages.english: It increases the power of your magical spells.
It increases your evasion after moving or waiting.
messages.translation: 移动或等待后，它提高你的闪避值。

messages.english: It increases your rate of magic regeneration.
messages.translation: 它提高你的魔力恢复速度。

messages.english: It increases the success rate of your magical spells.
messages.translation: 它提高你的施法成功率。

messages.english: It may silence you when you take damage.
messages.translation: 受伤时它可能使你陷入沉默。

messages.english: It inflicts you with a random bane when you equip it.
messages.translation: 装备它会使你受到一种随机灾厄。

messages.english: It increases the power of your Conjurations spells.
messages.translation: 它提高你的塑能系魔法的威力。

messages.english: It increases the power of your Hexes spells.
messages.translation: 它提高你的妖系法术威力。

messages.english: It increases the power of your Summonings spells.
messages.translation: 它提高你的召唤系魔法的威力。

messages.english: It increases the power of your Necromancy spells.
messages.translation: 它提高你的死灵系魔法的威力。

messages.english: It increases the power of your Translocations spells.
messages.translation: 它提高你的位移系魔法的威力。

messages.english: It increases the power of your Fire spells.
messages.translation: 它提高你的火系法术威力。

messages.english: It increases the power of your Ice spells.
messages.translation: 它提高你的冰系法术威力。

messages.english: It increases the power of your Air spells.
messages.translation: 它提高你的气系法术威力。

messages.english: It increases the power of your Earth spells.
messages.translation: 它提高你的土系法术威力。

messages.english: It increases the power of your Alchemy spells.
messages.translation: 它提高你的炼金术法术威力。

messages.english: It increases the power of your Forgecraft spells.
messages.translation: 它提高你的锻造术法术威力。

messages.english: It sustains your strength, intelligence and dexterity.
messages.translation: 它维持你的力量、智力与敏捷。

messages.english: It may teleport you next to monsters.
messages.translation: 它可能将你传送至怪物身旁。

messages.english: It can be evoked for teleport control.
messages.translation: 可以发动它以控制传送。

messages.english: It allows you to eat raw meat even when not hungry.
messages.translation: 它使你即使不饿也能吃下生肉。

messages.english: It protects your inventory from destruction.
messages.translation: 它保护你的物品栏免遭毁坏。

messages.english: It allows you to control your flight when levitating.
messages.translation: 它使你在悬浮时能够控制飞行。

messages.english: It reduces the accuracy of all your attacks.
messages.translation: 它降低你所有攻击的命中率。

messages.english: It causes incoming damage to be divided between your reserves of health and magic.
messages.translation: 它使你承受的伤害由生命与魔力共同承担。

messages.english: It allows you to gain divine favour quickly.
messages.translation: 它使你更快获得神祇的青睐。
它会反射被格挡的飞射物攻击。

messages.english: It improves your skill with shapeshifting (+5).
messages.translation: 它提高你的变形术技能（+5）。

messages.english: It restores some MP whenever you drink a potion and also enhances your alchemy spells.
messages.translation: 每当你饮用药水时，它会恢复一些魔力，并增强你的炼金术法术。

messages.english: It reduces the duration of hostile enchantments and decays magical contamination more quickly.
messages.translation: 它缩短敌对附魔的持续时间，并加快魔法污染的消退。

messages.english: You are unable to wield it.
It is too large for you to wield.
It can be maximally enchanted to +%d.
It is always destroyed on impact.
It has a 1/%d chance to be destroyed on impact.
messages.translation: 它命中后有 1/%d 的概率损毁。

messages.english: If you quaff this potion your AC would be %d.
messages.translation: 饮用此药水后，你的护甲值将为 %d。

messages.english: It affects your accuracy and damage with ranged weapons and melee (%+d).
messages.translation: 它影响你的远程武器与近战攻击的命中率和伤害（%+d）。

messages.english: It has a curse placed upon it.
Your spells cost less MP as you Rev up. Whenever you cast a spell, you make a melee attack against a random enemy in range.
messages.translation: 随着转速提高，你的施法魔力消耗降低。每当你施法时，你会对攻击范围内的随机敌人发动一次近战攻击。

messages.english: Your evocable items recharge 30% faster and wands have a 30% chance to not spend a charge.
messages.translation: 你的可发动道具充能速度提高 30%，魔杖有 30% 的概率不消耗充能。

messages.english: Your AC increases as you Rev (up to +5) and while fully Revved, your attacks may disarm enemies.
messages.translation: 随着转速提高，你的护甲值上升（最多 +5）；达到最高转速时，你的攻击可能缴械敌人。

messages.english: It sometimes fires a blinding ray at enemies whose attacks you dodge.
messages.translation: 当你闪避敌人的攻击时，它有时会向该敌人发射致盲射线。

messages.english: It is a fabulous contraption, custom-made by your own hands.
messages.translation: 它是你亲手打造的奇妙装置。

messages.english: However, it recharges as you gain experience.
messages.translation: 不过，它会随着你获取经验值而恢复充能。

messages.english: Enchanting this artefact any further is beyond even your skills.
messages.translation: 即使以你的技艺，也无法再为这件神器附魔。

messages.english: This ancient artefact cannot be changed by magic or mundane means.
messages.translation: 这件远古神器无法通过魔法或寻常手段改变。

messages.english: While standing here, you can exit the dungeon with the <w>%s</w> key.
messages.translation: 站在这里时，你可以按 <w>%s</w> 离开地下城。

messages.english: You have not yet explored it and cannot tell where it leads.
messages.translation: 你尚未探索过它，无法得知它通往何处。

messages.english: You can view the location it leads to by examining it with <w>%s</w> and pressing <w>%s</w>.
messages.translation: 你可以按 <w>%s</w> 查看它，再按 <w>%s</w> 查看目的地。

messages.english: Pray here with <w>%s</w> to learn more.
messages.translation: 在此按 <w>%s</w> 祈祷以了解更多。

messages.english: However, this will not work until the sealing runes wear off.
messages.translation: 不过，在封印符文消退之前无法这样做。

messages.english: A suitable weapon or spell can reach past it.
messages.translation: 合适的武器或法术可以越过它。

messages.english: Some spells can be cast through it.
Your servitor can be imbued with this spell.
messages.translation: 可以向你的仆从传授此法术。

messages.english: Your servitor could be imbued with this spell if your spell success rate were higher.
messages.translation: 若你的施法成功率更高，就能向你的仆从传授此法术。

messages.english: This inflicts up to 40% magical contamination when cast by you.
messages.translation: 由你施放时，此法术最多造成 40% 的魔法污染。

messages.english: This spell is empowered while you are enkindled.
messages.translation: 当你被点燃时，此法术会得到强化。

messages.english: You currently have no enchantments that could be removed by this.
messages.translation: 你目前没有会被此法术移除的附魔。

messages.english: <magenta>When cast via Aphotic Marionette, this spell will affect the player instead.
messages.translation: <magenta>通过无光提线偶施放时，此法术将改为影响玩家。

messages.english: Sparks flare out of its mouth and nostrils.
messages.translation: 火花从它的口鼻中喷出。
酸性烟雾在它周围盘旋。

messages.english: Venom drips from its jaws and stinger tail.
messages.translation: 毒液从它的口中与尾刺上滴落。

messages.english: Its outline shimmers with magical energy.
messages.translation: 它的轮廓闪烁着魔法能量。
烟雾从它的鼻孔中涌出。
寒霜从它的鼻孔中涌出。

messages.english: Its scales and tail are adapted to the water.
messages.translation: 它的鳞片与尾巴适于水中生活。

messages.english: It is cloaked in a pall of superheated steam.
messages.translation: 它笼罩在一团炽热蒸汽中。

messages.english: It will release varied jellies when damaged or killed, with the number of jellies proportional to the amount of damage.
messages.translation: 它受伤或死亡时会释放各种软泥怪，数量与受到的伤害成正比。

messages.english: It will release all of its jellies when polymorphed.
messages.translation: 它变形时会释放出所有软泥怪。
它看起来和你一模一样……真诡异！

messages.english: If struck, it will crumble away soon after.
messages.translation: 它被击中后，很快就会崩解。

messages.english: If struck, it will die soon after.
messages.translation: 它被击中后，很快就会死亡。

messages.english: Killing this monster yields no experience or items.
messages.translation: 杀死此怪物不会获得经验值或物品。
你的身影闪烁着重新显现。

messages.english: The sprites lose interest in your situation.
messages.translation: 精灵们对你的处境失去了兴趣。

messages.english: You lose your grip on the chains of life and death.
messages.translation: 你失去了对生死锁链的掌控。

messages.english: You feel a little less agile now.
messages.translation: 你感到不再那么敏捷了。

messages.english: You are possessed by a berserker rage.
You have got your breath back.
You feel a little less clever now.
messages.translation: 你感到头脑不再那么灵敏了。
你的法术威力被削弱了。

messages.english: Your spells return to their normal power.
messages.translation: 你的法术恢复了正常威力。
你的邪恶引导正在减弱。

messages.english: You are imbued with divine vigour.
You are protected by a layer of icy armour.
messages.translation: 一层寒冰护甲保护着你。

messages.english: You are armoured with a cloak of flame.
You are covered in liquid fire.
You feel a little less mighty now.
messages.translation: 你感到力量不再那么强大了。

messages.english: You feel more in control of yourself again.
messages.translation: 你再次感到能够掌控自己。

messages.english: You are resistant to the elements.
You start to feel less resistant.
messages.translation: 你开始感到抗性减弱了。

messages.english: Your slime is starting to congeal.
You are calling forth ooze from nearby walls.
messages.translation: 你正在从附近的墙壁中唤出黏液。

messages.english: You are standing in death's doorway.
Your time is quickly running out!
You are unable to enter death's door.
You step away from death's doorway.

messages.translation: 你感到不再那么隐秘了。

messages.english: You are in the eye of a polar vortex.
messages.translation: 你正处于极地涡流的中心。

messages.english: You are unleashing a barrage of alchemical reagents.
messages.translation: 你正释放出炼金试剂的弹幕。

messages.english: You are chanting a vengeful prayer.
messages.translation: 你正在诵经复仇的祷词。

messages.english: Your prayer is nearing its end.
You are channelling the inexorable grasp of Yredelemnul.
messages.translation: 你正在引导伊莱德莱姆努尔不可逃脱的掌控。

messages.english: You are liquefying the ground beneath you.
messages.translation: 你正在液化脚下的地面。

messages.english: The ground is no longer liquid beneath you.
messages.translation: 你脚下的地面不再液化。

messages.english: You possess the skills of a mighty hero.
messages.translation: 你拥有强大英雄的技艺。

messages.english: You are unable to create a polar vortex.
The winds around you calm down.

messages.translation: 你正在分离周围的空间。

messages.english: A sentinel's mark is revealing your location to enemies.
messages.translation: 哨兵印记将你的位置暴露给敌人。

messages.english: The sentinel's mark upon you fades away.
messages.translation: 你身上的哨兵印记消退了。

messages.english: Your melee and ranged attacks are strengthened by the souls of the fallen.
messages.translation: 亡者的灵魂强化了你的近战与远程攻击。

messages.english: You are losing your grip on the fallen.
messages.translation: 你正在失去对亡者的掌控。

messages.english: You are covered in terrible wounds.
messages.translation: 你满身都是可怖的伤口。

messages.english: Your attacks no longer feel as feeble.
messages.translation: 你的攻击不再那么无力了。

messages.english: You are firmly anchored to this plane.
messages.translation: 你被牢牢锚定在此位面。

messages.english: You are no longer firmly anchored in space.
messages.translation: 你不再被牢牢锚定在空间中。

messages.english: You are unable to move around.
You are able to move again.
You refuse to leave the level so soon after announcing yourself.
messages.translation: 刚刚宣告自己的到来，你不愿这么快就离开本层。

messages.english: You feel willing to depart the floor again.
messages.translation: 你再次愿意离开本层了。

messages.english: You are reciting Zin's Axioms of Law.
messages.translation: 你正在诵经辛的法则公理。

messages.english: You are ready to recite again.
You are more vulnerable to fire.
messages.translation: 你更容易受到火焰伤害。

messages.english: You feel less vulnerable to fire.
messages.translation: 你不再那么容易受到火焰伤害。

messages.english: Barbed spikes are embedded in your body.
You are more vulnerable to poison.
messages.translation: 你更容易受到毒素伤害。

messages.english: You feel less vulnerable to poison.
messages.translation: 你不再那么容易受到毒素伤害。

messages.english: You are partly encased in ice.
messages.translation: 你的部分身体被冰封住了。

messages.english: The ice encasing you melts away.
You are teleporting projectiles at a target.
messages.translation: 你正在将飞射物传送至目标。

messages.english: You are beckoning forth a horde of dragons.
The roar of the dragon horde subsides.
You are unable to call dragons.
You can once more reach out to the dragon horde.
Qazlal is protecting you from fire.
messages.translation: 卡兹拉尔保护你免受火焰伤害。

messages.english: You feel less protected from fire.
messages.translation: 你抵御火焰的防护减弱了。

messages.english: Your protection from fire is fading.
messages.translation: 你抵御火焰的防护即将消失。

messages.english: Qazlal is protecting you from cold.
messages.translation: 卡兹拉尔保护你免受寒冷伤害。

messages.english: You feel less protected from cold.
messages.translation: 你抵御寒冷的防护减弱了。

messages.english: Your protection from cold is fading.
messages.translation: 你抵御寒冷的防护即将消失。

messages.english: Qazlal is protecting you from electricity.
messages.translation: 卡兹拉尔保护你免受电击伤害。

messages.english: You feel less protected from electricity.
messages.translation: 你抵御电击的防护减弱了。

messages.english: Your protection from electricity is fading.
messages.translation: 你抵御电击的防护即将消失。

messages.english: Qazlal is protecting you from physical damage.
messages.translation: 卡兹拉尔保护你免受物理伤害。

messages.english: You feel less protected from physical attacks.
messages.translation: 你抵御物理攻击的防护减弱了。

messages.english: Your protection from physical attacks is fading.
messages.translation: 你抵御物理攻击的防护即将消失。

messages.english: You are horrified, weakening your attacks and spells.
messages.translation: 恐惧削弱了你的攻击与法术。

messages.english: You are shielded by the power of the Shining One.
messages.translation: 光明神的力量护佑着你。

messages.english: You are briefly shielded after casting or invoking.
messages.translation: 施法或祈祷后，你会短暂获得护盾。

messages.english: You are cleaving through your foes.
You are regenerating under the effects of ambrosia.
messages.translation: 你正在神酒的作用下恢复。

messages.english: You are rapidly regenerating magical energy.
messages.translation: 你的魔力正在迅速恢复。

messages.english: A terrible howling echoes in your mind.
messages.translation: 可怕的嚎叫在你脑海中回荡。

messages.english: Vertigo is making it harder to attack, cast, and dodge.
messages.translation: 眩晕使你更难攻击、施法和闪避。

messages.english: Your shed blood clings to and protects you.
messages.translation: 你流出的鲜血附着在身上，保护着你。

messages.english: Your blood armour dries and flakes away.
messages.translation: 你的鲜血护甲干涸剥落了。

messages.english: Your weapon is exuding a protective aura.
messages.translation: 你的武器散发着防护光环。

messages.english: You are ready to hop once more.
You feel energetic enough to blinkbolt again.
messages.translation: 你的精力足以再次使用闪现雷击了。

messages.english: You are acrobatic and have increased evasion.
messages.translation: 你身手矫健，闪避值提高。

messages.english: You are rapidly regenerating health and magic.
messages.translation: 你的生命与魔力正在迅速恢复。

messages.english: You are unable to speak a word of chaos.
You are ready to speak a word of chaos again.
messages.translation: 你又能说出混沌真言了。

messages.english: Casting spells may cause you to lose access to your magic.
messages.translation: 施法可能使你暂时无法使用魔法。
你的魔法似乎不再那么污浊了。

messages.english: You are unable to cast spells.
You regain access to your magic.
messages.translation: 你重新获得了施法能力。

messages.english: You are rising toward the ceiling.
Your sickness prevents you from regenerating health.
messages.translation: 疾病使你无法恢复生命。
你感到健康状况好转了。

messages.english: You feel ready to blink again.
You are unable to cast Gavotte.
messages.translation: 你无法施放加沃特舞曲。
你附近的重力恢复了稳定。

messages.english: You are unable to cast Hellfire Mortar.
messages.translation: 你无法施放地地狱火迫击炮。

messages.english: You feel ready to split the earth once more.

messages.translation: 你的收割光环正在减弱。

messages.english: You are unable to siphon essence.
You are ready to siphon essence again.
You are unable to performed a blood rite.
Your swarm has recently come to your defense.
messages.translation: 你的虫群刚刚保护过你。

messages.english: Your orb of stardust has temporarily expended its magic.
messages.translation: 你的星尘宝珠暂时耗尽了魔力。

messages.english: Your orb of mesmerism has temporarily expended its magic.
messages.translation: 你的魅惑宝珠暂时耗尽了魔力。

messages.english: Your orb has recharged its mesmeric power.
messages.translation: 你的宝珠恢复了魅惑之力。

messages.english: Your hands have recently discharged their full voltage.
messages.translation: 你的双手刚刚释放过全部电力。

messages.english: You are surrounded by jinxing sprites.
The jinxing sprites lose interest in you.
messages.translation: 厄咒精灵对你失去了兴趣。

messages.english: You are unable to call your canine familiar.
Your familiar recovers from its injuries.
messages.translation: 你的魔宠从伤势中恢复了。

messages.english: You are enveloped in primordial darkness.
Night gives way to day once more.
The further away your target is the more your accuracy is reduced.
messages.translation: 目标越远，你的命中率降低得越多。

messages.english: The sign of ruin enfeebles you when you suffer attacks.
messages.translation: 毁灭征兆会在你受到攻击时削弱你。

messages.english: The sign of ruin upon you fades.
messages.translation: 你身上的毁灭征兆消退了。

messages.english: You are beckoning forth the legions of chaos.
You are surrounded by a whirlwind of blades.
You feel a little less murderous for the moment.
messages.translation: 你暂时不再那么杀气腾腾了。

messages.english: Your Destruction is growing increasingly wild.
messages.translation: 你的毁灭之力正变得愈发狂野。
你在空间中失去了锚定。

messages.english: You are making an unholy racket with your haunted armour.
messages.translation: 你附身的防具正发出邪异的喧嚣。

messages.english: Your flames burn bright with remembrance.
messages.translation: 回忆使你的火焰熊熊燃烧。

messages.english: Your strikes ignite an explosive catalyst.
messages.translation: 你的攻击会点燃爆炸催化剂。

messages.english: Your shroud of slime is broken and needs time to repair.
messages.translation: 你的黏液帷幕已破碎，需要时间修复。
你的黏液帷幕重新长好了。

messages.english: Your melee attacks are strengthened by primal bloodlust.
messages.translation: 原始嗜血欲望强化了你的近战攻击。
你感到嗜血欲望正在消退。

messages.english: You are parrying attacks and have increased SH.
messages.translation: 你正在招架攻击，格挡值提高。
你不再那么诡计多端了。

messages.english: Your maw is digesting a delicious meal.
messages.translation: 你的巨口正在消化美餐。

messages.english: You break out of your daze.
You feel the effects of Trog's Hand fading.
messages.translation: 你感到特洛格之手的效果正在消退。

messages.english: You are spewing a noxious bog.
You have covered nearby walls with an icy ambush.
messages.translation: 你在附近墙壁上布下了冰霜伏击。

messages.english: Heavenly clouds are increasing your accuracy and damage.
messages.translation: 天界云雾提高了你的命中率与伤害。

messages.english: A servant of Beogh has come to challenge you.
messages.translation: 一位比欧弗的仆从前来挑战你。

messages.english: You are seeking vengeance for the death of your brethren.
messages.translation: 你正为同胞的死亡寻求复仇。

messages.english: The regenerative ooze finishes dripping off of you.
messages.translation: 你身上的再生黏液已全部滴落。

messages.english: The world around you seems to dim momentarily.
messages.translation: 周围的世界似乎暗淡了一瞬。

messages.english: Strange energies run through your body.
messages.translation: 奇异的能量流遍你的身体。
你感到一股恶毒的气息。

messages.english: Something just walked over your grave. No, really!
messages.translation: 有什么东西刚刚走过你的坟墓。不，是真的！

messages.english: You hear strange and distant voices.
messages.translation: 你听到远处传来奇怪的声音。
一位被遗忘的神祇惩击了你%s

messages.english: You can bribe the following branches of the dungeon:
messages.translation: 你可以贿赂地下城中的以下分支：

messages.english: Ashenzari supports the following skill groups because of your curses:
messages.translation: 由于你的诅咒，艾申扎利强化了以下技能组：

messages.english: Orcs frequently recognise you as Beogh's chosen one.
messages.translation: 兽人经常认出你是比欧弗的神选者。

messages.english: Orcs sometimes recognise you as one of their own.
messages.translation: 兽人有时会将你视为同族。

messages.english: Jellies are peaceful and will consume items off the floor.
messages.translation: 软泥怪保持和平，并会吞食地上的物品。

messages.english: Jiyva prevents you from harming jellies.
messages.translation: 吉瓦使你无法伤害软泥怪。

messages.english: You can memorise some of Vehumet's spells.
messages.translation: 你可以记忆维胡梅特赐予的一些法术。

messages.english:
You are surrounded by an umbra.
Foes that die within your umbra may be raised as undead servants.
messages.translation:
暗影光环环绕着你。
死于你的暗影光环内的敌人可能被复活为亡灵仆从。

messages.english: Your life essence is reduced. (-10%% HP)
messages.translation: 你的生命本质受到削弱。（生命上限 -10%%）

messages.english: Your Destruction is augmented by the power of Gehenna.
messages.translation: 欣嫩谷的力量强化了你的毁灭之力。

messages.english: Your Destruction is augmented by the power of Cocytus.
messages.translation: 悲叹河的力量强化了你的毁灭之力。

messages.english: Your Destruction is augmented by the power of Tartarus.
messages.translation: 塔尔塔罗斯的力量强化了你的毁灭之力。

messages.english: Your Destruction is augmented by the power of Dis.
messages.translation: 冥府的力量强化了你的毁灭之力。

messages.english: Your Destruction will be augmented by one of the Four Hells.
messages.translation: 四大地狱之一的力量将强化你的毁灭之力。

messages.english: Jiyva will unlock the Slime Pits vaults.
messages.translation: 吉瓦将开启史莱姆巢穴的宝库。
请只输入 [Y] 是或 [n] 否。

messages.english: It possesses the following wand spells:
It has mastered the following spells, which are affected by silence and antimagic:
messages.translation: 它掌握以下法术，会受到沉默与反魔法影响：

messages.english: It possesses the following divine abilities, which are affected by silence:
messages.translation: 它拥有以下神授能力，会受到沉默影响：

messages.english: It possesses the following magical abilities, which are affected by antimagic (but not silence):
messages.translation: 它拥有以下魔法能力，会受到反魔法影响，但不受沉默影响：

messages.english: It possesses the following natural abilities, which are affected by silence:
messages.translation: 它拥有以下天生能力，会受到沉默影响：

messages.english: It possesses the following natural abilities:

messages.translation: 你处于启明状态。（意志增强）

messages.english: You may recruit a defeated apostle into your service
messages.translation: 你可以招募一名被击败的使徒为你效力

messages.english: A glorious shadow in the eyes of %s.
A shining star in the eyes of %s.
A rising shadow in the eyes of %s.
A rising star in the eyes of %s.
%s is almost ready to forgive your sins.
%s' wrath will not burn much longer.
%s prevents you from stabbing unaware foes.
messages.translation: %s使你无法刺杀未察觉你的敌人。
它大幅降低你的意志力。
它大幅提高你的意志力。

messages.english: It makes you much less stealthy.
messages.translation: 它大幅降低你的潜行能力。

messages.english: It makes you much more stealthy.
messages.translation: 它大幅提高你的潜行能力。

messages.english: It makes you extremely vulnerable to %s.
It makes you very vulnerable to %s.
messages.translation: 它使你很容易受到%s伤害。

messages.english: It renders you almost immune to %s.
%s appears from out of thin air!
Pikel's spell is broken, but his former minions can only feel hate for you!
messages.translation: 皮克尔的法术被打破了，但他曾经的仆从们对你只有仇恨！

messages.english: Pikel's spell is broken, but his former minion can only feel hate for you!
messages.translation: 皮克尔的法术被打破了，但他曾经的仆从对你只有仇恨！

messages.english: With Pikel's spell broken, his former minions thank you for their freedom.
messages.translation: 皮克尔的法术被打破后，他曾经的仆从们感谢你使他们重获自由。

messages.english: With Pikel's spell broken, his former minion thanks you for its freedom.
messages.translation: 皮克尔的法术被打破后，他曾经的仆从感谢你使其重获自由。

messages.english: Expiring: You are possessed by a berserker rage.
messages.translation: 即将结束：你正陷入狂暴之怒。

messages.english: Expiring: You are channelling the dead.
messages.translation: 即将结束：你正在引导亡者。
即将结束：神力赋予你活力。

messages.english: Expiring: You are protected by a layer of icy armour.
messages.translation: 即将结束：一层寒冰护甲保护着你。

messages.english: Expiring: You are armoured with a cloak of flame.
messages.translation: 即将结束：烈焰披风保护着你。

messages.english: Expiring: You are turning to stone.
messages.translation: 即将结束：你正在变成石头。

messages.english: Expiring: You are resistant to the elements.
messages.translation: 即将结束：你能够抵抗元素伤害。
即将结束：你能够迅速移动。

messages.english: Expiring: You are standing in death's doorway.
messages.translation: 即将结束：你正置身于死亡之门。
即将结束：你散发出沉默。

messages.english: Expiring: You are in the eye of a polar vortex.
messages.translation: 即将结束：你正处于极地涡流的中心。

messages.english: Expiring: You are unleashing a barrage of alchemical reagents.
messages.translation: 即将结束：你正释放出炼金试剂的弹幕。

messages.english: Expiring: You are chanting a vengeful prayer.
messages.translation: 即将结束：你正在诵经复仇的祷词。

messages.english: Expiring: You are disjoining your surroundings.
messages.translation: 即将结束：你正在分离周围的空间。

messages.english: Expiring: A sentinel's mark is revealing your location to enemies.
messages.translation: 即将结束：哨兵印记将你的位置暴露给敌人。

messages.english: Expiring: Your melee and ranged attacks are strengthened by the souls of the fallen.
messages.translation: 即将结束：亡者的灵魂强化了你的近战与远程攻击。

messages.english: Expiring: You are covered in terrible wounds.
messages.translation: 即将结束：你满身都是可怖的伤口。

messages.english: Expiring: You refuse to leave the level so soon after announcing yourself.
messages.translation: 即将结束：刚刚宣告自己的到来，你不愿这么快就离开本层。

messages.english: Expiring: You are briefly shielded after casting or invoking.
messages.translation: 即将结束：施法或祈祷后，你会短暂获得护盾。

messages.english: Expiring: You are reanimating the dead.
messages.translation: 即将结束：你正在复活死者。

messages.english: Expiring: You are surrounded by jinxing sprites.
messages.translation: 即将结束：厄咒精灵环绕着你。

messages.english: Expiring: You are unable to call your canine familiar.
messages.translation: 即将结束：你无法召唤犬类魔宠。

messages.english: Expiring: You may recruit a defeated apostle into your service
messages.translation: 即将结束：你可以招募一名被击败的使徒为你效力

messages.english: Expiring: You are enveloped in primordial darkness.
messages.translation: 即将结束：原初黑暗笼罩着你。

messages.english: Expiring: The further away your target is the more your accuracy is reduced.
messages.translation: 即将结束：目标越远，你的命中率降低得越多。

messages.english: Expiring: You are beckoning forth the legions of chaos.
messages.translation: 即将结束：你正在召唤混沌军团。

messages.english: Expiring: You are surrounded by a whirlwind of blades.
messages.translation: 即将结束：刀刃旋风环绕着你。

messages.english: Expiring: Your Destruction is growing increasingly wild.
messages.translation: 即将结束：你的毁灭之力正变得愈发狂野。

messages.english: Expiring: You are making an unholy racket with your haunted armour.
messages.translation: 即将结束：你附身的防具正发出邪异的喧嚣。

messages.english: Expiring: Your flames burn bright with remembrance.
messages.translation: 即将结束：回忆使你的火焰熊熊燃烧。

messages.english: Expiring: Your strikes ignite an explosive catalyst.
messages.translation: 即将结束：你的攻击会点燃爆炸催化剂。
黏液帷幕修复中（即将结束）

messages.english: Expiring: Your shroud of slime is broken and needs time to repair.
messages.translation: 即将结束：你的黏液帷幕已破碎，需要时间修复。

messages.english: Expiring: Your melee attacks are strengthened by primal bloodlust.
messages.translation: 即将结束：原始嗜血欲望强化了你的近战攻击。
即将结束：你感到诡计多端。

messages.english: Expiring: Your willpower is greatly increased.
messages.translation: 即将结束：你的意志力大幅提高。

messages.english: It is larval and weak, freshly emerged from its mother's pouch.
messages.translation: 它刚从母亲的育儿袋中爬出，尚处于虚弱的幼体阶段。

messages.english: It is a juvenile, no longer larval but below its mature strength.
messages.translation: 它已脱离幼体阶段，但尚未达到成年时的力量。

messages.english: It is mature, stronger than a juvenile but weaker than its elders.
messages.translation: 它已经成年，比幼兽更强，但不及年长的同类。

messages.english: It is an elder, stronger than mature beasts.
messages.translation: 它是一头长者，比普通成年个体更强。

messages.english: It is a primal beast, the most powerful of its kind.
messages.translation: 它是一头原始巨兽，是同类中最强大的个体。

messages.english: %s returns to the mists of memory.
%s is dazed by the mutagenic energy.
Beep! Your pager goes off! Use _ to check your messages.
messages.translation: 哔！你的寻呼器响了！按 _ 查看消息。

messages.english: Error! The help for %s is missing!
The tide is released from %s's call.

messages.translation: 可见的%s<lightgray>（选择以查看说明）</lightgray>
可见的%s<lightgray>（选择以查看说明，按%s切换至%s）</lightgray>

messages.english: You begin to imprint %s upon your paragon.
messages.translation: 你开始将%s铭刻于你的白金典范。

messages.english: You finish imprinting the physical structure of %s upon your paragon.
messages.translation: 你已将%s的物理构造铭刻于你的白金典范。

messages.english: You begin to imbue your servitor with knowledge of %s.
messages.translation: 你开始向你的仆从灌注%s的知识。
你可以诵读辛的法则公理。
你可以祈求辛赐予活力。

messages.english: call upon Zin to imprison the lawless
messages.translation: 你可以祈求辛囚禁不法者。

messages.english: call upon Zin to create a sanctuary
messages.translation: 你可以祈求辛创造庇护所。

messages.english: Zin will cleanse your potions of mutation.
messages.translation: 辛会净化你的变异药水。

messages.english: You and your allies can gain power from killing the unholy and evil.
messages.translation: 你与你的盟友可以通过杀死不洁与邪恶生物获取力量。

messages.english: call upon the Shining One for a divine shield
messages.translation: 你可以祈求光明神赐予神圣护盾。
你可以引导净化火焰的爆发。

messages.english: The Shining One will bless your weapon with holy wrath... once.
messages.translation: 光明神将以神圣之怒祝福你的武器……仅此一次。

messages.english: bring forth the wretched and dying
messages.translation: 你可以唤来可怜的濒死者。

messages.english: Kikubaaqudgha protects you from necromantic miscasts and death curses.
messages.translation: 奇库巴库哈保护你免受死灵魔法误施与死亡诅咒的影响。

messages.english: Kikubaaqudgha protects you from unholy torment.
messages.translation: 奇库巴库哈保护你免受邪恶的折磨。

messages.english: Kikubaaqudgha will grant you forbidden knowledge or bloody your weapon with pain... once.
messages.translation: 奇库巴库哈将赐予你禁忌知识，或以痛苦染血你的武器……仅此一次。

messages.english: Kikubaaqudgha will grant you forbidden knowledge.
messages.translation: 奇库巴库哈将赐予你禁忌知识。

messages.english: light the black torch and reap souls in Yredelemnul's name
messages.translation: 你可以点燃黑色火炬，以伊莱德莱姆努尔之名收割灵魂。
你可以召回收割而来的亡灵。

messages.english: Yredelemnul will gift you temporary undead servants when you light the torch.
messages.translation: 点燃火炬时，伊莱德莱姆努尔会赐予你临时的亡灵仆从。
你可以投掷成团的暗影炬光。
你可以束缚活体的灵魂。

messages.english: engulf your surroundings in Yredelemnul's grip
messages.translation: 你可以用伊莱德莱姆努尔的掌控笼罩周围。
你可以通过杀敌恢复魔力。
维胡梅特增强你的毁灭性法术。

messages.english: Vehumet extends the range of your destructive spells.
messages.translation: 维胡梅特延长你的毁灭性法术的射程。

messages.english: Okawaru requires that you fight alone, and prevents you from gaining allies.
messages.translation: 奥格瓦如要求你独自战斗，使你无法获得盟友。
你可以暂时获得高超的技艺。
你可以加快战斗中的攻击速度。

messages.english: enter into single combat with a foe
messages.translation: 你可以与一名敌人展开单挑。

messages.english: Okawaru will gift you throwing weapons as you gain piety.
messages.translation: 随着你的虔诚增长，奥格瓦如会赐予你投掷武器。

messages.english: Okawaru will grant you a choice of weapons... once.
messages.translation: 奥格瓦如将让你挑选一件武器……仅此一次。

messages.english: Okawaru will grant you a choice of armour... once.
messages.translation: 奥格瓦如将让你挑选一件防具……仅此一次。
你可以通过杀敌恢复生命。
你可以释放马科列布的毁灭之力。

messages.english: summon an infernal servant of Makhleb
messages.translation: 你可以召唤马科列布的地狱仆从。

messages.english: Makhleb will allow you to brand your body with an infernal mark... once.
messages.translation: 马科列布将允许你在身上烙印地狱印记……仅此一次。

messages.english: call upon Sif Muna for magical energy
messages.translation: 你可以祈求席夫·穆纳赐予魔力。

messages.english: freely open your mind to new spells
messages.translation: 你可以自由地敞开心灵，学习新的法术。

messages.english: call upon Sif Muna to cast any spell from your library
messages.translation: 你可以祈求席夫·穆纳施放法术库中的任意法术。

messages.english: Sif Muna will gift you books as you gain piety.
messages.translation: 随着你的虔诚增长，席夫·穆纳会赐予你法术书。

messages.english: call upon Trog for regeneration and willpower
messages.translation: 你可以祈求特洛戈赐予再生与意志力。

messages.english: Trog will gift you melee weapons as you gain piety.
messages.translation: 随着你的虔诚增长，特洛戈会赐予你近战武器。
你可以从力量牌组中抽牌。

messages.english: Nemelex will gift you decks of power as you gain piety.
messages.translation: 随着你的虔诚增长，尼姆雷斯・索布会赐予你力量牌组。

messages.english: choose one out of three cards
messages.translation: 你可以从三张牌中选取一张。

messages.english: deal four cards at a time
messages.translation: 你可以一次发出四张牌。

messages.english: stack five cards from your decks
messages.translation: 你可以从牌组中叠放五张牌。

messages.english: heal and attempt to pacify others
messages.translation: 你可以治疗其他生物并尝试使其和平。

messages.english: call upon Elyvilon for divine vigour
messages.translation: 你可以祈求艾利维隆赐予神圣活力。

messages.english: Lugonu protects you from the effects of unwielding distortion weapons.
messages.translation: 卢戈努保护你免受放下扭曲武器的影响。

messages.english: Lugonu may banish nearby foes when other gods try to punish you.
messages.translation: 其他神祇试图惩罚你时，卢戈努可能放逐附近的敌人。
你可以将自己传送至深渊。

messages.english: Lugonu will corrupt your weapon with distortion... once.
messages.translation: 卢戈努将以扭曲之力腐化你的武器……仅此一次。

messages.english: Beogh will send orc apostles to challenge you in battle as you gain piety.
messages.translation: 随着你的虔诚增长，比欧弗会派遣兽人使徒前来挑战你。

messages.english: You can recruit apostles that you defeat into your service.
messages.translation: 你可以招募被你击败的使徒为你效力。

messages.english: Your apostles are sometimes healed when you deal damage.
messages.translation: 当你造成伤害时，你的使徒有时会得到治疗。
你可以集结复仇的军团。

messages.english: Jiyva protects you from corrosive effects.
messages.translation: 吉瓦保护你免受腐蚀效果影响。

messages.english: Jiyva will mutate your body as you gain piety.
messages.translation: 随着你的虔诚增长，吉瓦会使你的身体发生变异。

messages.english: call acidic ooze from nearby walls
messages.translation: 你可以从附近墙壁中唤出酸性黏液。
你可以将敌人化为黏液。

messages.english: You may expel jellies when seriously injured.
messages.translation: 你受到重伤时可能释放出软泥怪。

messages.english: You can walk through plants and fire through allied plants.
messages.translation: 你可以穿过植物，并让攻击穿过友方植物。

messages.english: encircle yourself with summoned briar patches
messages.translation: 你可以召唤荆棘丛环绕自身。
你可以培育一株弹道真菌。

messages.english: transform dungeon walls and trees into plant allies
messages.translation: 你可以将地下城墙壁与树木转化为植物盟友。
你可以培育一株奥克罗布植物。

messages.english: Cheibriados slows the effects of poison on you.
messages.translation: 切布理亚多延缓毒素对你的作用。
你可以扭曲时间，使其他生物减速。

messages.english: warp the flow of time around you
messages.translation: 你可以扭转周围的时间流动。

messages.english: inflict damage on those overly hasty
messages.translation: 你可以对过于急躁的生物造成伤害。

messages.english: step out of the flow of time

Ashenzari warns you of distant threats and treasures.
Ashenzari shows you where magical portals lie.
messages.translation:
艾申扎利会警告你远处的威胁与宝藏。
艾申扎利会指示魔法传送门的位置。
艾申扎利鉴定你拥有的物品。
艾申扎利揭示不可见的事物。
艾申扎利使你的心智保持清明。

messages.english: Ashenzari protects you from the dungeon's malevolent forces.
messages.translation: 艾申扎利保护你免受地下城中恶意力量的侵扰。

messages.english: Ashenzari reveals the structure of the nearby dungeon.
messages.translation: 艾申扎利揭示附近地下城的结构。

messages.english: Dithmenos quiets all noise in your surroundings.
messages.translation: 迪斯姆诺使你周围的一切声音安静下来。

messages.english: Your shadow sometimes tangibly mimics your actions.
messages.translation: 你的影子有时会化为实体，模仿你的行动。

messages.english: mislead enemies by swapping places with your shadow
messages.translation: 你可以与影子交换位置，误导敌人。

messages.english: unleash an enemy's spells as if they were a marionette
messages.translation: 你可以将敌人当作提线偶，释放其法术。
你可以让无法穿透的黑夜环绕自身。

messages.english: Gozag turns your defeated foes' bodies to gold.
messages.translation: 哥萨戈将被你击败的敌人的尸体化为黄金。

messages.english: Your enemies may become distracted by gold.
messages.translation: 你的敌人可能因黄金而分心。
你可以向哥萨戈请求药水效果。

messages.english: fund merchants seeking to open stores in the dungeon
messages.translation: 你可以资助打算在地下城开店的商人。

messages.english: bribe branches to halt enemies' attacks and recruit allies
messages.translation: 你可以贿赂分支，让敌人停止攻击并招募盟友。

messages.english: Qazlal grants you and your divine allies immunity to clouds.
messages.translation: 卡兹拉尔使你与你的神授盟友免疫云雾。

messages.english: You are surrounded by a storm.
call upon nature to destroy your foes
messages.translation: 你可以呼唤自然之力摧毁敌人。
你可以赋予附近的云雾生命。

messages.english: The storm surrounding you is powerful enough to repel missiles.
messages.translation: 环绕你的风暴足够强大，能够排斥飞射物。

messages.english: You can perform multiple auxiliary attacks with your blades.

messages.english: You are resistant to unholy torment.
