messages.translation: 你的所有行动都很缓慢。

messages.english: You have a powerful constriction melee attack.
messages.translation: 你拥有强力的近战绞缠攻击。

messages.english: You can wear a hat or helmet on each head.
messages.translation: 你的每个头都能戴一顶帽子或头盔。

messages.english: You have a powerful clawing attack.
Your giant scaled body is strong and resilient, but less evasive.
messages.translation: 你巨大的鳞片身躯强壮坚韧，但不够灵活。

messages.english: Your melee attacks drain, slow and weaken victims.
messages.translation: 你的近战攻击会吸能、减速并削弱受害者。

messages.english: You can torment nearby foes to heal from their wounds.
messages.translation: 你能折磨附近的敌人，从他们的创伤中获得治疗。

messages.english: You are immune to unholy pain and torment.
messages.translation: 你免疫邪恶的痛苦和折磨。

messages.english: You recover more slowly from Doom and Banes.
messages.translation: 你从厄运和厄咒中恢复得更慢。

messages.english: You are tiny, dextrous, and very evasive.
messages.translation: 你体型微小，动作灵巧，很难被击中。

messages.english: Your unarmed attacks are very weak.

messages.translation: 你的树皮十分坚硬，但你几乎无法闪避。

messages.english: Your unarmed attacks smack enemies forcefully with your branches.
messages.translation: 你的徒手攻击会用树枝猛烈抽打敌人。

messages.english: You are immune to unholy torment.
Your roots penetrate the ground, keeping you stationary.
messages.translation: 你的根须深入地面，使你无法移动。

messages.english: You are insubstantial and cannot be petrified, ensnared, or set on fire.
messages.translation: 你的身躯虚无缥缈，无法被石化、缠困或点燃。

messages.english: You are highly resistant to most damage types. (rF++, rC++, rN+++, rElec, rCorr)
messages.translation: 你对大多数类型的伤害都有很高的抗性。（火抗++、冰抗++、负能量抗性+++、电抗、腐蚀抗性）

messages.english: You are resistant to acid and immune to corrosive walls.
messages.translation: 你能抵抗酸液，且免受腐蚀墙壁的影响。

messages.english: Your amorphous body is immune to blinding, drowning, and ensnarement.
messages.translation: 你无定形的身体免疫致盲、溺水和缠困。

messages.english: Your melee attacks splash acid on your foes.
messages.translation: 你的近战攻击会向敌人泼洒酸液。

messages.english: You cast all spells with heavily decreased power.
messages.translation: 你的所有法术威力都大幅降低。

messages.english: Your melee attacks release spores that confuse breathing creatures.
messages.translation: 你的近战攻击释放的孢子会使需要呼吸的生物混乱。

messages.english: You become terrified and freeze when enemies are visible.
messages.translation: 有敌人在视野内时，你会因恐惧而僵住。

messages.english: Damage taken is halved, but you are drained when taking damage.
messages.translation: 你受到的伤害减半，但受伤时会受到吸能。

messages.english: You bleed smoke when taking damage.
Your spells are much less powerful.
messages.translation: 你的法术威力大幅降低。

messages.english: You can devour living enemies to heal.
messages.translation: 你能吞噬活着的敌人来治疗自身。

messages.english: Your electrical attacks strike out in all directions at once.
messages.translation: 你的电击会同时攻击各个方向。

messages.english: You can turn into living lightning.
Your quills sometimes injure those who attack you in melee.
messages.translation: 你的棘刺有时会刺伤近战攻击你的敌人。

messages.english: Your maw can bite with vicious strength.
messages.translation: 你的巨口能够凶猛地撕咬。

messages.english: You can devour enemies to increase your regeneration.
messages.translation: 你能吞噬敌人来提高再生速度。

messages.english: Your maw sometimes becomes mesmerised by tasty morsels.
messages.translation: 你的巨口有时会被美味的食物迷住。

messages.english: Your maw has eaten a hole through body armour, reducing its AC.
messages.translation: 你的巨口咬穿了躯干防具，使其护甲值降低。

messages.english: Foes you strike become dangerously contaminated with transmutational energy.
messages.translation: 被你击中的敌人会受到危险的变形能量污染。

messages.english: You glow with energy, making you easy to see.
messages.translation: 你散发能量光芒，很容易被发现。
你受到的伤害减少三分之一。
你通过击杀获得的治疗翻倍。

messages.english: You will endure the Crucible once your slaughter is complete.
messages.translation: 屠戮结束后，你将承受血肉熔炉的考验。

messages.english: Your fangs allow you to drain the lifeblood from your enemies.
messages.translation: 你的尖牙使你能够吸取敌人的生命之血。

messages.english: When you kill a living creature with a stab, you may create a vampiric thrall.
messages.translation: 你刺杀活物时，有机会创造吸血奴仆。

messages.english: You can occasionally transform into a swarm of bats.
messages.translation: 你偶尔能够变成蝙蝠群。

messages.english: You often daze monsters when they first notice you.
messages.translation: 怪物刚察觉到你时，经常会被你震慑。

messages.english: You do not regenerate when monsters are visible.
messages.translation: 有怪物在视野内时，你无法再生。

messages.english: You freeze nearby walls in an area that expands as you fight.
messages.translation: 你会冻结附近的墙壁，战斗时范围逐渐扩大。

messages.english: You can cast Ice magic more easily.
messages.translation: 你能更容易地施放冰系魔法。

messages.english: When at low health, angry bees swarm out to defend you.
messages.translation: 生命值较低时，愤怒的蜜蜂会蜂拥而出保护你。

messages.english: You regenerate HP and MP more quickly.
messages.translation: 你的生命值和魔法值恢复得更快。

messages.english: Your aqueous body allows to you attack from a distance.
messages.translation: 你的水体使你能够从远处攻击。

messages.english: When injured, pools of shallow water form around you.
messages.translation: 受伤时，你周围会形成浅水池。

messages.english: You can command nearby water to drown your enemies.
messages.translation: 你能驱使附近的水淹没敌人。

messages.english: When hit by fire damage, your body sometimes produces steam.
messages.translation: 受到火焰伤害时，你的身体有时会产生蒸汽。

messages.english: When hit by cold damage, your body sometimes freezes.
messages.translation: 受到寒冷伤害时，你的身体有时会冻结。

messages.english: You unleash cutting winds upon enemies you strike.
messages.translation: 你会向击中的敌人释放割裂之风。

messages.english: Hexes are much easier for you to cast and harder to resist.
messages.translation: 你更容易施放妖术系魔法，敌人也更难抵抗它们。

messages.english: You often pose riddles to enemies when you first see then.
messages.translation: 初次看到敌人时，你经常会向他们出谜语。

messages.english: You gain temporary slaying when you kill enemies in melee.
messages.translation: 你在近战中击杀敌人时，会获得临时杀戮加成。

messages.english: You sometimes unleash a terrifying howl when you kill enemies in melee.
messages.translation: 你在近战中击杀敌人时，有时会发出恐怖的嚎叫。

messages.english: You can leap to fearful enemies and eviscerate them.
messages.translation: 你能跃向恐惧中的敌人，将其开膛破肚。

messages.english: You have increased skill with all magical schools.
messages.translation: 你所有魔法学派的技能都得到提高。

messages.english: Your melee attacks sometimes restore your MP.
messages.translation: 你的近战攻击有时会恢复魔法值。

messages.english: You cannot cast spells above level 4.
messages.translation: 你无法施放高于4级的法术。

messages.english: Your melee attacks are very weak.
Your body armour is fused into your shell, improving its AC and properties.
messages.translation: 你的躯干防具与甲壳融合，提高其护甲值及属性。

messages.english: You can exhale clouds of rust.
You manifest a globe of solar heat that you carry with you.
messages.translation: 你会显现出一颗随你移动的太阳热球。

messages.english: Your solar ember damages enemies next to it every second time you attack.
messages.translation: 你每攻击两次，太阳余烬就会伤害其身边的敌人。

messages.english: You heal your solar ember whenever you swap places with it.
messages.translation: 你与太阳余烬交换位置时会治疗它。

messages.english: Your melee attacks sometimes make enemies vulnerable to fire.
messages.translation: 你的近战攻击有时会使敌人变得易受火焰伤害。

messages.english: You can cast Fire magic much more easily.
messages.translation: 你能更容易地施放火系魔法。

messages.english: Your tendrils poison nearby enemies when you attack.
messages.translation: 你攻击时，触须会使附近的敌人中毒。

messages.english: When significantly injured, you may petrify poisoned enemies.
messages.translation: 受到重创时，你可能会石化中毒的敌人。

messages.english: Electricity sometimes discharges through enemies you attack.
messages.translation: 你攻击敌人时，有时会释放穿过敌人的电流。

messages.english: When badly injured, your eels discharge electricity violently.
messages.translation: 受到重创时，你的电鳗会猛烈放电。

messages.english: Your melee attacks may weaken breathing enemies.
messages.translation: 你的近战攻击可能会削弱需要呼吸的敌人。

messages.english: Your melee attacks cause explosive burstshrooms to grow.
messages.translation: 你的近战攻击会使能够爆炸的爆裂蘑菇生长。

messages.english: Your %s is a mass of colorful fungus.
messages.translation: 你的%s变成了一团彩色真菌。

messages.english: Your %s was a mass of colorful fungus.
messages.translation: 你的%s曾变成一团彩色真菌。

messages.english: You offer yourself as an instrument of Makhleb's will and feel overwhelming power flowing through you!
messages.translation: 你献身成为马科列布意志的工具，感到压倒性的力量涌遍全身！

messages.english: You carve a gateway into yourself and beckon forth the legions of chaos!
messages.translation: 你在自己身上刻出一道门，召来混沌军团！

messages.english: You are already unleashing the legions of chaos!
messages.translation: 你已经在释放混沌军团！
你的毁灭之力狂野地涌动！

messages.english: Your accumulated destruction dissipates without a target.
messages.translation: 你积蓄的毁灭之力因没有目标而消散。

messages.english: Slime begins to ooze from the nearby walls!
messages.translation: 黏液开始从附近的墙壁中渗出！

messages.english: There are no walls around you to affect.
messages.translation: 你周围没有可影响的墙壁。

messages.english: You feel like a meek peon again.
messages.translation: 你又觉得自己像个卑微的苦工。

messages.english: You feel invigorated by the roar of the crowd!
messages.translation: 观众的欢呼声使你精神振奋！
你无法与那个目标决斗！

messages.english: You can see no monster there to duel!
messages.translation: 你看不到那里有可决斗的怪物！

messages.english: The air is filled with shimmering golden clouds!

messages.english: Remember to rest between fights and to enter unexplored terrain with full health and magic. Ideally you should retreat into areas you've already explored and cleared of monsters; resting on the edge of the explored terrain increases the chances of your rest being interrupted by wandering monsters. To rest, press <w>5</w> or <w>Shift-numpad 5</w><tiles>, or <w>click the rest button</w></tiles>.
messages.translation: 记得在战斗之间休息，并在生命和魔力全满时探索未知区域。最好退回已经探索、清除了怪物的区域；在已探索区域的边缘休息，更容易被游荡的怪物打断。按 <w>5</w> 或 <w>Shift-numpad 5</w><tiles>，或<w>点击休息按钮</w></tiles>即可休息。

messages.english: Also, berserking might help you not to lose so much health in the first place. To use your abilities press <w>a</w>.
messages.translation: 此外，狂暴或许能让你在战斗中少损失一些生命。按 <w>a</w> 使用能力。

messages.english: Your console settings allowing, you'll always see a list of monsters somewhere on the screen.
messages.translation: 如果终端设置允许，屏幕上会一直显示怪物列表。

messages.english: You can gain information about it by pressing <w>x</w> and moving the cursor over the monster, and read the monster description by then pressing <w>v</w>.
messages.translation: 按 <w>x</w> 并将光标移到怪物上即可查看信息，再按 <w>v</w> 阅读怪物说明。

messages.english: To attack this monster with your wielded weapon, just move into it.
messages.translation: 要用手持武器攻击这只怪物，只需向它移动。

messages.english: Note that as long as there's a non-friendly monster in view you won't be able to automatically move to distant squares, to avoid death by misclicking.
messages.translation: 注意：只要视野内有非友好的怪物，你就无法自动移动到远处的方格，以免误点致死。

messages.english: However, as a hunter you will want to deal with it using your bow. If you have a look at your shortbow from your <w>i</w>nventory, you'll find an explanation of how to do this.
messages.translation: 不过，作为猎手，你应当用弓对付它。在物品栏（<w>i</w>）中查看短弓，即可了解操作方法。

messages.english:
First <w>w</w>ield it, then follow the instructions.<tiles>
As a short-cut you can also <w>right-click</w> on your shortbow to read its description, and <w>left-click</w> to wield it.</tiles>
messages.translation:
先按 <w>w</w> 持用它，再按照说明操作。<tiles>
也可以<w>右键点击</w>短弓阅读说明，<w>左键点击</w>持用。</tiles>

messages.english: <tiles>Clicking with your <w>right mouse button</w> on your shortbow will also let you read its description.</tiles>
messages.translation: <tiles>用<w>鼠标右键</w>点击短弓也能阅读说明。</tiles>

messages.english: However, as a conjurer you will want to deal with it using magic. If you look at the help entry for the <w>M</w>emorisation screen you'll find an explanation of how to do this.
messages.translation: 不过，作为塑能师，你应当用魔法对付它。查看法术记忆界面（<w>M</w>）的帮助说明，即可了解操作方法。

messages.english: This screen shows your character's set of talents. You can gain new abilities via certain items, through religion or by way of mutations. Activation of an ability usually comes at a cost, e.g. Magic power. Press '<w>!</w>' or '<w>?</w>' to toggle between ability selection and description.
messages.translation: 此界面显示角色拥有的能力。某些物品、信仰和变异可以赋予你新的能力。发动能力通常需要付出代价，例如消耗魔力。按“<w>!</w>”或“<w>?</w>”可在能力选择与说明之间切换。

messages.english: This screen shows the skill set of your character. The number next to the skill is your current level, the higher the better. <w>Training</w> displays training percentages. <w>Costs</w> displays relative training costs. <w>Targets</w> displays skill training targets. You can toggle which skills to train by pressing their slot letters. A <darkgrey>grey</darkgrey> skill will not be trained and ease the training of others.
messages.translation: 此界面显示角色的技能。技能旁的数字是当前等级，越高越好。<w>训练</w>显示训练百分比，<w>花费</w>显示相对训练花费，<w>目标</w>显示技能训练目标。按技能对应的字母可切换是否训练该技能。<darkgrey>灰色</darkgrey>技能不会被训练，因此其他技能可获得更多训练。

messages.english: The training percentage (in <brown>brown</brown>) shows the relative amount of the experience gained which will be used to train each skill. It is automatically set depending on which skills you have used recently. Disabling a skill sets the training rate to 0.
messages.translation: 训练百分比（<brown>棕色</brown>）表示获得的经验值中，用于训练各项技能的相对份额。它会根据你最近使用的技能自动设置。关闭某项技能的训练会将其训练比例设为 0。

messages.english: The training cost (in <cyan>cyan</cyan>) shows the experience cost to raise the given skill one level, relative to the cost of raising an aptitude zero skill from level zero to level one.
messages.translation: 训练花费（<cyan>青色</cyan>）表示该技能提升一级所需的经验值，相对于天资为零的技能从零级升到一级所需经验值的倍数。

messages.english: Press the letter of a skill to set a training target. When the target is reached a message will appear and the training of the skill will be disabled.
messages.translation: 按技能对应的字母可设置训练目标。达到目标时会显示消息，并停止训练该技能。

messages.english: This screen shows the skill set of your character. Press the letter of a skill to read its description, or press <w>?</w> again to return to the skill selection.
messages.translation: 此界面显示角色的技能。按技能对应的字母可阅读说明，再按 <w>?</w> 返回技能选择。

messages.english: This screen shows the spells in your spell library. From here you can memorise spells by selecting them, as well as view spell descriptions, search for them, and organize them. As a conjurer, you start with five memorisable spells, and one already memorised: Magic Dart. (To view memorised spells, you can exit this menu and select <w>I</w>.)
messages.translation: 此界面显示法术库中的法术。你可以选择法术进行记忆，也可以查看说明、搜索和整理法术。塑能师开局有五个可记忆的法术，以及一个已记忆的法术：魔法飞弹。（要查看已记忆的法术，可以退出此菜单并按 <w>I</w>。）

messages.english: A spell that isn't <darkgray>grayed out</darkgray> or <lightred>forbidden</lightred> can be memorised right away by selecting it at this menu.
messages.translation: 没有<darkgray>变灰</darkgray>或被<lightred>禁止</lightred>的法术，可以在此菜单中选择并立即记忆。

messages.english: When wielded, some weapons (such as this one) offer certain abilities you can activate.
messages.translation: 某些武器（例如这件）在持用时会赋予你可发动的能力。

messages.english: You can wield this weapon with <w>%</w>, or use <w>%</w> to switch between the weapons in slot a and b. (Use <w>%i</w> to adjust item slots.)
messages.translation: 按 <w>%</w> 可持用这件武器，按 <w>%</w> 可在物品栏 a 和 b 两个位置的武器之间切换。（按 <w>%i</w> 可调整物品位置。）

messages.english: To attack a monster, you can simply walk into it.
messages.translation: 要攻击怪物，只需向它移动。

messages.english: Because of your horns you cannot wear helmets. (Press <w>%</w> to see a list of your mutations and innate abilities.)
messages.translation: 由于长有角，你无法戴头盔。（按 <w>%</w> 可查看变异和先天能力。）

messages.english: Only nagas and armataurs can wear barding.
messages.translation: 只有娜迦和犰狳人能穿身甲。

messages.english: Note that body armour with a high encumbrance rating may hinder your ability to cast spells. Light armour such as robes and leather armour will be generally safe for any aspiring spellcaster.
messages.translation: 注意：累赘值高的躯干防具可能妨碍施法。长袍和皮甲等轻型防具通常适合有志于施法的角色。

messages.english: Note that shields will hinder your ability to cast spells, until you've gained enough Shields skill to remove the penalty.
messages.translation: 注意：盾牌会妨碍施法，直到你的盾牌技能足以消除惩罚。

messages.english: Note that many ranged weapons are two handed and so cannot be used with an offhand item.
messages.translation: 注意：许多远程武器需要双手持用，无法与副手物品同时使用。

messages.english: The magic within can be unleashed by evoking (<w>%</w>) it.
messages.translation: 按唤发键（<w>%</w>）可释放其中的魔法。

messages.english: A manual can greatly help you in training a skill. After you pick one up, the skill in question will be trained more efficiently and will level up faster until you exhaust the manual's contents.
messages.translation: 手册能极大地帮助你训练技能。拾取后，对应技能的训练效率会提高，升级更快，直到手册内容耗尽。

messages.english: You can pick up a spellbook to add its spells to your spell library. (View your spell library with <w>%</w>.)
messages.translation: 拾取魔法书可将其中的法术加入法术库。（按 <w>%</w> 查看法术库。）

messages.english: Skeletons and corpses can be used as components for certain necromantic spells. Apart from that, they are largely useless.
messages.translation: 骸骨和尸体可作为某些死灵法术的材料，除此之外基本没有用途。

messages.english: This staff can enhance your spellcasting, making spells of its related spell school more powerful.
messages.translation: 这根法杖能增强施法，使对应魔法学派的法术威力更强。

messages.english: Miscellaneous items sometimes harbour magical powers that can be harnessed by e<w>%</w>oking the item.
messages.translation: 杂项物品有时蕴含魔法力量，可以通过唤发（<w>%</w>）使用。

messages.english: These nasty constructions can cause a range of unpleasant effects. You won't be able to avoid tripping traps by flying over them; their magic construction will cause them to be triggered anyway.
messages.translation: 这些危险的机关会造成各种不良效果。飞过陷阱也无法避免触发，其魔法构造仍会使它启动。

messages.english:
The dungeon contains a number of natural obstacles such as shafts, which lead one to three levels down. Once you know the shaft is there, you can safely step over it.
If you want to jump down there, use <w>></w> to do so. Be warned that getting back here might be difficult.
messages.translation:
地下城里有一些天然障碍，例如会让你坠落一至三层的竖井。一旦知道竖井的位置，就可以安全地跨过。
如果想跳下去，按 <w>></w> 即可。小心，返回这里可能很困难。

messages.english: Some areas of the dungeon, such as the Spider Nest, may be strewn with giant webs that may ensnare you for a short time. Insects, oozes and incorporeal entities can navigate the webs safely.
messages.translation: 地下城的某些区域（例如蜘蛛巢）可能遍布巨大的蛛网，能将你短暂困住。昆虫、软泥和无实体的生物可以安全通过蛛网。

messages.english: You can enter the next (deeper) level by following them down (<w>></w>). To get back to this level again, press <w><<</w> while standing on the upstairs.
messages.translation: 站在楼梯上按下楼键（<w>></w>），可进入更深一层。要返回本层，站在上楼楼梯上按 <w><<</w>。

messages.english: In Tiles, you can achieve the same, in either direction, by clicking the <w>left mouse button</w>.
messages.translation: 在图形版中，<w>鼠标左键</w>点击楼梯也可上下楼。

messages.english: You have not yet passed through this particular set of stairs.
messages.translation: 你还没有走过这处楼梯。

messages.english: These stairs lead out of the dungeon. Following them will end the game. The only way to win is to transport the fabled Orb of Zot outside.
messages.translation: 这处楼梯通向地下城外，走出去会结束游戏。只有将传说中的佐特宝珠带到外面，才能获胜。

messages.english: You can enter the previous (shallower) level by following these up (<w><<</w>). This is ideal for retreating or finding a safe resting spot, since the previous level will have less monsters, and monsters on this level can't follow you up unless they're standing right next to you. To get back to this level again, press <w>></w> while standing on the downstairs.
messages.translation: 站在楼梯上按上楼键（<w><<</w>），可进入较浅一层。这适合撤退或寻找安全的休息地点，因为上一层的怪物较少，而本层的怪物只有紧挨着你才能跟上楼。要返回本层，站在下楼楼梯上按 <w>></w>。

messages.english: In Tiles, you can perform either action simply by clicking the <w>left mouse button</w> instead.
messages.translation: 在图形版中，这两种操作也都可以用<w>鼠标左键</w>点击楼梯完成。

messages.english: Escape hatches can be used to quickly leave a level with <w><<</w> and <w>></w>, respectively. Note that you will usually be unable to return right away.
messages.translation: 逃生通道可让你快速离开当前楼层，分别使用 <w><<</w> 和 <w>></w>。注意，通常无法立即原路返回。

messages.english: To avoid accidentally opening a door you'd rather remain closed during travel or autoexplore, you can mark it with an exclusion from the map view (<w>X</w>) with <w>ee</w> while your cursor is on the grid in question. Such an exclusion will prevent autotravel from ever entering that grid until you remove the exclusion with another press of <w>Xe</w>.
messages.translation: 为了避免自动移动或自动探索时误开某扇门，可以进入地图界面（<w>X</w>），将光标移到该格并按 <w>ee</w> 设置移动禁区。自动移动将不会进入该格，直到你再次按 <w>Xe</w> 取消移动禁区。

messages.english: This is your chance to join a religion! In general, the gods will help their followers, bestowing powers of all sorts upon them, but many of them demand a life of dedication, constant tributes or entertainment in return.
messages.translation: 这是加入信仰的机会！神通常会帮助信徒，赐予各种力量，但许多神也要求信徒奉献一生、不断献祭或取悦他们。

messages.english: This particular altar is so ancient that you cannot make out which god it is dedicated to! Converting here by pressing <w>></w> while standing on the altar will enter you into service of a random god, who will grant you some additional piety in thanks.
messages.translation: 这座祭坛年代久远，已无法辨认供奉的是哪位神！站在祭坛上按 <w>></w> 改信，会使你成为某位随机神的信徒，并获得一些额外虔诚作为答谢。

messages.english: An entryway into one of the many dungeon side branches in Crawl.
messages.translation: 这是通往地下城众多分支之一的入口。

messages.english: Beware, sometimes these can be deadly!
messages.translation: 小心，有些分支十分致命！

messages.english: Did you think you were the only adventurer in the dungeon? Well, you thought wrong! These unique adversaries often possess skills that normal monsters wouldn't, so be careful.
messages.translation: 你以为自己是地下城里唯一的冒险者吗？那可就错了！这些独一无二的敌人往往拥有普通怪物所没有的本领，务必小心。

messages.english: The ghost of a deceased adventurer, it would like nothing better than to send you the same way.
messages.translation: 这是一位已故冒险者的鬼魂，它最想做的就是让你步其后尘。

messages.english: This monster appears to be really dangerous!
messages.translation: 这只怪物看起来极其危险！

messages.english: This monster appears to be quite dangerous.
messages.translation: 这只怪物看起来相当危险。

messages.english: A berserking monster is bloodthirsty and fighting madly. Such a blood rage makes it particularly dangerous!
messages.translation: 狂暴的怪物嗜血而疯狂地战斗，这种怒火使它格外危险！

messages.english: Friendly monsters will follow you around and attempt to aid you in battle. You can order nearby allies by <w>t</w>alking to them.
messages.translation: 友好的怪物会跟随你，并尝试协助战斗。按 <w>t</w> 交谈可向附近的盟友下令。

messages.english: However, it is only <w>temporarily</w> friendly, and will become dangerous again when this friendliness wears off.
messages.translation: 不过，它只是<w>暂时</w>友好；友好状态消失后，它会再次变得危险。

messages.english: You can easily mark its square as dangerous to avoid accidentally entering into its field of view when using auto-explore or auto-travel. To do so, enter targeting mode with <w>x</w> and then press <w>e</w> when your cursor is hovering over the monster's grid. Doing so will mark this grid and all surrounding ones within a radius of 8 as "excluded" ones that explore or travel modes won't enter.
messages.translation: 可以将它所在的方格标为危险，避免自动探索或自动移动时意外进入它的视野。按 <w>x</w> 进入瞄准模式，将光标移到怪物所在的方格，再按 <w>e</w>。这会将该格及周围半径 8 格的区域设为“移动禁区”，自动探索和自动移动都不会进入。

messages.english: Apparently it has not noticed you - yet. Note that you do not have to engage every monster you meet. Sometimes, discretion is the better part of valour.
messages.translation: 它似乎还没有注意到你——暂时如此。你不必与遇到的每只怪物交战，有时谨慎比勇猛更明智。

messages.english: Apparently it has been distracted by something. You could use this opportunity to sneak up on this monster - or to sneak away.
messages.translation: 它似乎被什么东西分散了注意力。你可以趁机悄悄靠近，也可以悄悄离开。

messages.english: This monster doesn't appear to have any resistances or susceptibilities. It cannot fly and is of average speed. Examining other, possibly more high-level monsters can give important clues as to how to deal with them.
messages.translation: 这只怪物似乎没有抗性或弱点，不能飞行，速度普通。查看其他更强怪物的说明，可以获得应对它们的重要线索。

messages.english: That monster is %s. You can learn about any monster by hovering your mouse over it, and read its description by <w>right-clicking</w> on it.
messages.translation: 那只怪物是%s。将鼠标悬停在任何怪物上即可查看信息，<w>右键点击</w>可阅读说明。

messages.english: That %s is a monster, usually depicted by a letter. Some typical early monsters look like <brown>r</brown>, <green>l</green>, <brown>K</brown> or <lightgrey>g</lightgrey>.
messages.translation: 那个 %s 是怪物，通常用字母表示。初期常见的怪物有 <brown>r</brown>、<green>l</green>、<brown>K</brown> 和 <lightgrey>g</lightgrey>。

messages.english: This might be a good time to run away or apply your Berserk <w>a</w>bility.
messages.translation: 现在或许该逃跑，或使用狂暴能力（<w>a</w>）。

messages.english: This might be a good time to run away.

You will then enter target mode with the nearest monster or previous target selected. Cycle through visible hostile monsters with <w>+</w> or <w>-</w>. Press <w>f</w>, <w>Enter</w> or <w>.</w> to fire. If you miss, <w>%s</w> fires at the same target again.
messages.translation: 随后会进入瞄准模式，自动选中最近的怪物或上次的目标。按 <w>+</w> 或 <w>-</w> 可在视野内的敌对怪物之间切换。瞄准后，按 <w>f</w>、<w>Enter</w> 或 <w>.</w> 发射。若未命中，按 <w>%s</w> 可再次攻击同一目标。

messages.english: Open the ability menu with <w>%s</w> and select the corresponding ability. Activation may fail, especially without training.
messages.translation: 按 <w>%s</w> 打开能力菜单，再选择对应的能力。发动可能失败，尤其是在缺乏训练时。

messages.english: You can also right-click your avatar.
messages.translation: 也可以右键点击自己的角色图像。

messages.english: When wielded, some weapons (such as this one) offer abilities you can activate.
messages.translation: 某些武器（例如这件）在持用时会赋予你可发动的能力。

messages.english: Wield this weapon with <w>%s</w>, or switch between weapons in slots a and b with <w>%s</w>. Adjust item slots with <w>%s</w>i.
messages.translation: 按 <w>%s</w> 可持用这件武器，按 <w>%s</w> 可在 a 和 b 位置的武器之间切换。按 <w>%s</w>i 可调整物品位置。

messages.english: You've trained <w>%s</w> for a while, so consider continuing with it instead of <w>%s</w>. Press <w>%s</w> to see the skill values.
messages.translation: 你已经训练了一段时间的<w>%s</w>，或许应继续训练它，而不是<w>%s</w>。按 <w>%s</w> 可查看具体技能数值。

messages.english: Left-click a monster to attack it.
messages.translation: 左键点击怪物即可攻击。

messages.english: Press <w>%s</w> to fire your ranged weapon.
To attack a monster, simply walk into it.
messages.translation: 要攻击怪物，只需向它移动。

messages.english: %s can be fired with <w>%s</w> without a launcher.
messages.translation: %s无需发射器，按 <w>%s</w> 即可投掷。

messages.english: Press <w>%s</w> to fire, then <w>%s</w> to select this item.
messages.translation: 按 <w>%s</w> 发射，再按 <w>%s</w> 选择这件物品。

messages.english: Press <w>%s</w> to fire and select this item.
messages.translation: 按 <w>%s</w> 发射并选择这件物品。

messages.english: Your horns prevent you from wearing helmets. Press <w>%s</w> to view your mutations and innate abilities.
messages.translation: 由于长有角，你无法戴头盔。按 <w>%s</w> 可查看变异和先天能力。

messages.english: Only nagas and armataurs can wear barding.
messages.translation: 只有娜迦和犰狳人能穿身甲。

messages.english: Wear armour with <w>%s</w> and remove it with <w>%s</w>.
messages.translation: 按 <w>%s</w> 穿防具，按 <w>%s</w> 脱下。

messages.english: Clicking its tile also performs either action.
messages.translation: 点击防具图块也能穿脱。

messages.english: Body armour with a high encumbrance rating may hinder spellcasting. Robes and leather armour are generally safe for aspiring spellcasters.
messages.translation: 累赘值高的躯干防具可能妨碍施法。长袍和皮甲通常适合有志于施法的角色。

messages.english: Shields hinder spellcasting until your Shields skill is high enough to remove the penalty.
messages.translation: 盾牌会妨碍施法，直到你的盾牌技能足以消除惩罚。

messages.english: Many ranged weapons require two hands and cannot be used with an offhand item.
messages.translation: 许多远程武器需要双手持用，无法与副手物品同时使用。

messages.english: Weapons and armour with unusual descriptions like this are more likely to have higher enchantment or special properties, good or bad.
messages.translation: 像这样描述不同寻常的武器和防具，更有可能拥有较高的强化值或特殊属性，可能有益，也可能有害。

messages.english: When worn, some armour (such as this one) offers abilities you can activate with <w>%s</w>.
messages.translation: 某些防具（例如这件）在穿戴时会赋予你可发动的能力，按 <w>%s</w> 使用。

messages.english: Evoke this wand with <w>%s</w> to release its magic.
messages.translation: 按 <w>%s</w> 唤发这根魔杖，释放其中的魔法。

messages.english: Alternatively, hold <w>%s</w> and <w>left-click</w> a monster (or yourself) and select a wand, or <w>left-click</w> the wand tile and then the target.
messages.translation: 也可以按住 <w>%s</w> 并<w>左键点击</w>怪物（或自己），再从菜单选择魔杖；或者<w>左键点击</w>魔杖图块，再左键点击目标。

messages.english: Put on jewellery with <w>%s</w> and remove it with <w>%s</w>.
messages.translation: 按 <w>%s</w> 戴上首饰，按 <w>%s</w> 摘下。

messages.english: Clicking it in your inventory also performs either action.
messages.translation: 点击物品栏中的首饰也能戴上或摘下。

messages.english: When worn, some jewellery (such as this one) offers abilities you can activate with <w>%s</w>.
messages.translation: 某些首饰（例如这件）在佩戴时会赋予你可发动的能力，按 <w>%s</w> 使用。

messages.english: A manual greatly helps train a skill. After you pick it up, the corresponding skill trains more efficiently until the manual's contents are exhausted.
messages.translation: 手册能极大地帮助你训练技能。拾取后，对应技能的训练效率会提高，直到手册内容耗尽。

messages.english: Pick up a spellbook to add its spells to your library. View the library with <w>%s</w>.
messages.translation: 拾取魔法书可将其中的法术加入法术库。按 <w>%s</w> 查看法术库。

messages.english: Skeletons and corpses can be components for certain necromantic spells, but are otherwise largely useless.
messages.translation: 骸骨和尸体可作为某些死灵法术的材料，除此之外基本没有用途。

messages.english: This staff enhances the power of spells of its related school.
messages.translation: 这根法杖能增强对应魔法学派的法术威力。

messages.english: Since %s disapproves of magic, this staff is of little use to you. You may as well drop it with <w>%s</w>.
messages.translation: 由于%s厌恶魔法，这根法杖对你用处不大，不如按 <w>%s</w> 丢弃。

messages.english: Some miscellaneous items contain magical powers you can harness by evoking them with <w>%s</w>.
messages.translation: 某些杂项物品蕴含魔法力量，按 <w>%s</w> 唤发即可使用。

messages.english: This weapon offers protection from certain damage sources. Press <w>%s</w> to view your resistances and other attributes.
messages.translation: 这件武器能抵御某些伤害。按 <w>%s</w> 可查看抗性及其他属性。

messages.english: This armour offers protection from certain sources. Press <w>%s</w> to view your resistances and other attributes.
messages.translation: 这件防具能抵御某些伤害。按 <w>%s</w> 可查看抗性及其他属性。

messages.english: This ring offers protection from certain sources. Press <w>%s</w> to view your resistances and other attributes.
messages.translation: 这枚戒指能抵御某些伤害。按 <w>%s</w> 可查看抗性及其他属性。

messages.english: This amulet offers protection from certain sources. Press <w>%s</w> to view your resistances and other attributes.
messages.translation: 这枚护身符能抵御某些伤害。按 <w>%s</w> 可查看抗性及其他属性。

messages.english: It also offers protection from certain sources. Press <w>%s</w> to view your resistances and other attributes.
messages.translation: 它还能抵御某些伤害。按 <w>%s</w> 可查看抗性及其他属性。

messages.english: You cannot memorise any more spells right now. This will change as you gain levels and Spellcasting proficiency.
messages.translation: 你目前无法记忆更多法术。随着等级和施法技能提高，情况会改变。

messages.english: You cannot memorise any spells right now. This will change as you gain levels and Spellcasting proficiency.
messages.translation: 你目前无法记忆法术。随着等级和施法技能提高，情况会改变。

messages.english: To cast a spell, hold <w>Control</w> and <w>left-click</w> a monster (or yourself), then select a spell. You can also switch to the spellcasting display by <w>clicking</w> its <w>tab</w>.
messages.translation: 施法时，可以按住 <w>Control</w> 并<w>左键点击</w>怪物（或自己），再选择法术。也可以<w>点击</w>对应的<w>标签页</w>，切换到施法界面。

messages.english: Press <w>%s</w> and choose a spell, e.g. <w>a</w> (check with <w>?</w>). For attack spells,
messages.translation: 按 <w>%s</w> 并选择法术，例如 <w>a</w>（按 <w>?</w> 查看）。使用攻击法术时，

messages.english: %s is probably dangerous; stay out of it if you can.
%s is currently harmless, but that could change. Check your resistances on the overview screen (<w>%s</w>).
messages.translation: %s目前没有危险，但情况可能变化。可在概览界面（<w>%s</w>）查看抗性。

messages.english: This cloud is opaque. You cannot see a square if two or more opaque clouds lie between you and it.
messages.translation: 这片云雾不透明。如果你与某格之间隔着两格或更多的不透明云雾，就看不到该格中的事物。

messages.english: Stand on the altar and press <w>></w> for information about <w>%s</w>. You will be asked to confirm before converting.
messages.translation: 站在祭坛上按 <w>></w>，可查看<w>%s</w>的信息。改信之前会要求你确认。

messages.english: This altar is too ancient to identify its god, and %s probably will not like a change of allegiance. If you accept the risk, stand on it and press <w>></w> to serve a random god, who will grant some extra piety.
messages.translation: 这座祭坛年代久远，已无法辨认供奉的神，而%s大概不会喜欢你改换信仰。如果愿意冒险，站在祭坛上按 <w>></w>，就会成为某位随机神的信徒，并获得一些额外虔诚作为答谢。

messages.english:
%s probably will not like a change of allegiance, but looking is safe. Stand on the altar and press <w>></w> for information about <w>%s</w>. You will be asked to confirm before converting and abandoning your current faith.
Press <w>^</w> to see your current standing with %s.
messages.translation:
%s大概不会喜欢你改换信仰，不过看看无妨。站在祭坛上按 <w>></w>，可查看<w>%s</w>的信息。在改信并放弃当前信仰之前，会要求你确认。
按 <w>^</w> 可查看你与%s的当前关系。

messages.english: You can also hold <w>Shift</w> and <w>right-click</w> your avatar.
messages.translation: 也可以按住 <w>Shift</w> 并用<w>鼠标右键</w>点击自己的角色图像。

messages.english: Uh-oh, %s excommunicated you because your piety ran out. Perhaps you repeatedly broke the religious rules, did not please your god often enough, or both. Find an altar to %s to re-convert, and all will be well.
messages.translation: 糟了，由于虔诚耗尽，%s将你逐出了教门。也许你多次违背教规，也许你没有经常取悦神，或两者兼有。找到%s的祭坛重新皈依，就能恢复关系。

messages.english: If abandoning %s no longer seems wise and you want to return to your old faith, find an altar to %s and re-convert; all will be well.
messages.translation: 如果你觉得放弃%s并不明智，想重拾旧信仰，就找到%s的祭坛重新皈依，恢复关系。

messages.english: Otherwise you must endure this god's displeasure until their wrath is spent.
messages.translation: 否则，你就得忍受这位神的不满，直到神怒耗尽。

messages.english: Fortunately, %s does not seem to mind your conversion to %s.
messages.translation: 幸运的是，%s似乎不介意你改信%s。
你甚至保留了一些虔诚！

messages.english: This alliance exists only among the three good gods; do not expect it to be the norm.
messages.translation: 这种联盟只存在于三位善神之间，别把它当作惯例。

messages.english: Fortunately, %s does not seem to mind your conversion to %s. As one of the good gods, %s usually forgives changes of faith, unless you take the path of evil, in which case retribution can be nasty!
messages.translation: 幸运的是，%s似乎不介意你改信%s。%s是善神之一，通常对改换信仰较为宽容；但若你走上邪恶之路，惩罚可就十分可怕了！

messages.english: %s did not appreciate your conversion to %s! What else could you expect from changing from a good god to an evil one? %s would have been more forgiving towards a god on the same side of the faith.
messages.translation: %s不喜欢你改信%s！从善神改信邪神，你还能指望什么呢？如果新神不站在信仰的对立面，%s本来会宽容得多。

messages.english: %s did not appreciate your conversion to %s! Usually only the three good gods forgive this kind of faithlessness.
messages.translation: %s不喜欢你改信%s！通常只有三位善神会宽恕这种背弃信仰的行为。

messages.english: Unfortunately, converting back would appease %s but annoy %s, so you must suffer the wrath of one god or the other.
messages.translation: 可惜，改信回去虽然能平息%s的不满，却会激怒%s，因此你总得承受一位神的怒火。

messages.translation: 你掌控魔法的能力受到了干扰。

messages.translation: 你掌控魔法的能力受到了更强的干扰。

messages.translation: 你掌控魔法的能力不再受到干扰。

messages.translation: 你掌控魔法的能力受到的干扰减弱了。

messages.translation: 你消耗魔力(3点)来强化魔杖。

messages.translation: 你感到自己的魔法本质与地下城的魔杖联系了起来。

messages.translation: 你的魔法本质不再与地下城的魔杖相连。

你的经验极其欠缺。(经验等级-3)
你感到自己不那么老练了。

messages.english: Your paws help you pounce on unaware monsters.
messages.translation: 你的爪掌有助于扑向毫无察觉的怪物。

messages.english: You are missing an eye, making it more difficult to aim.
messages.translation: 你缺少一只眼睛，瞄准更加困难。

messages.english: Your right eye vanishes! The world loses its depth.
messages.translation: 你的右眼消失了！世界失去了纵深。

messages.english: Your right eye suddenly reappears! The world regains its depth.
messages.translation: 你的右眼突然重现！世界重新有了纵深。

messages.english: You are sensitive to extremes of temperature. (rF-, rC-)
messages.translation: 你对极端温度敏感。(火抗-，冰抗-)

messages.translation: 你感到自己对极端温度敏感。

messages.translation: 你不再对极端温度敏感

messages.english: You can no longer voluntarily change form.
messages.translation: 你无法再主动改变形态了。

messages.english: You can once more change form.
You have an uncanny knack for detecting items.
messages.translation: 你有探测物品的奇特本领。

messages.english: You suddenly feel aware of treasure.
You no longer feel aware of treasure.

messages.translation: 你能抵抗酸液。(腐蚀抗性)
你感到自己能够抵抗酸液了。

messages.english: You feel less resistant to acid.
messages.translation: 你感到抵抗酸液的能力减弱了。

messages.english: Your four strong arms can wield two-handed weapons with a shield.
messages.translation: 你强壮的四条手臂能让你同时使用双手武器和盾牌。

messages.english: Two of your arms shrink away.
messages.translation: 你的两条手臂缩回去了。
你长出了两条额外的手臂。

messages.english: You gain the ability to drink.
You have a special connection with the divine. (Faith)
messages.translation: 你与神圣力量有特殊联系。(信仰)

messages.english: You feel connected to something greater than you.
messages.translation: 你感到自己与更伟大的存在相连。

messages.english: You reflexively headbutt those who attack you in melee.
messages.translation: 你会反射性地用头撞击近战攻击你的敌人。
你的反击反应感觉很敏锐。
你的反击反应感觉迟钝了。

messages.english: You are immune to the effects of steam.
You are now immune to the effects of steam.
messages.translation: 你现在免疫蒸汽的影响了。

messages.english: You are no longer immune to the effects of steam.
messages.translation: 你不再免疫蒸汽的影响。

messages.english: You are incapable of wielding weapons or throwing items.
messages.translation: 你无法持握武器或投掷物品。

messages.english: You can no longer grasp objects.
You can no longer wear armour.
You gain extra lives every three experience levels.
messages.translation: 你每升三级就会获得额外生命。

messages.english: You can now gain extra lives.
messages.translation: 你现在能获得额外生命了。

messages.english: Your experience applies equally to all skills.
messages.translation: 你的经验值会平均用于所有技能。

messages.translation: 你的经验值现在会平均用于所有技能。

messages.english: Your experience no longer applies equally to all skills.
messages.translation: 你的经验值不再平均用于所有技能。

messages.english: You are camouflaged when in or above water. (Stealth+)
messages.translation: 你在水中或水上时会得到伪装。(潜行+)

messages.english: You are very nimble when in or above water. (Stealth+, EV+, Speed+++)
messages.translation: 你在水中或水上时非常灵活。(潜行+，闪避值+，速度+++)

messages.english: You feel very comfortable near water.
messages.translation: 你感到靠近水非常舒适。

messages.english: You feel less comfortable near water.
messages.translation: 你感到靠近水没那么舒适了。

messages.english: You have tentacles for arms and can constrict enemies.
messages.translation: 你的手臂是触手，能够缠绕敌人。
你的手臂感觉变成了触手。

messages.english: Your arms no longer feel tentacular.
messages.translation: 你的手臂不再感觉是触手了。

messages.english: Your lower body shifts to a powerful aquatic tail in water.
messages.translation: 在水中，你的下半身会变成强壮的水生尾巴。
你的双腿感觉适合水中活动。

messages.english: Your legs no longer feel aquatic.
messages.translation: 你的双腿不再感觉适合水中活动。

messages.english: You float through the air rather than walking.
messages.translation: 你不步行，而是飘浮在空中。

messages.english: You feel both weightless and legless.
messages.translation: 你感到自己既没有重量，也没有双腿。

messages.english: You feel dragged down by the weight of the world.
messages.translation: 你感到被世界的重量拖向地面。

messages.english: You learn spells naturally, not from books.
messages.translation: 你会自然学会法术，不依靠书籍。

messages.english: You feel mystic power welling inside you.
messages.translation: 你感到神秘的力量在体内涌动。

messages.english: You feel a greater respect for book-learning.
messages.translation: 你感到自己更加尊重书本学习了。

messages.english: Your magical power is your life essence.
messages.translation: 你的魔力就是你的生命本质。

messages.english: Your magical power and health merge together.
messages.translation: 你的魔力与生命值融合了。
你的生命与魔法不再相连。
你的生命力更强。(最大生命值+4)

messages.english: You have much superior vitality. (+8 MHP)
messages.translation: 你的生命力强大得多。(最大生命值+8)

messages.english: You have exceptionally superior vitality. (+12 MHP)
messages.translation: 你的生命力异常强大。(最大生命值+12)

messages.english: Your melee attacks may flood your foes with ooze.
messages.translation: 你的近战攻击可能将黏液灌入敌人体内。

messages.english: You have an extended range of vision and can be seen from far away.
messages.translation: 你的视野更广，也更容易被远处发现。

messages.english: The darkness flees at your approach.
The shadows grow bolder once more.
messages.translation: 阴影再次变得大胆起来。

messages.english: Your divine heritage dramatically boosts your attributes as you level up.
messages.translation: 你的神圣血统使你的属性随等级提升而大幅增长。
你感到自己更有神性了。
你感到自己更加凡俗了。

messages.english: You thrive by killing the living.
messages.translation: 你通过杀死活物而茁壮成长。

messages.english: You feel less hungry for flesh.
messages.translation: 你感到对血肉的渴望减弱了。

messages.english: You are easily found by Zot.
You feel your time running out.
messages.translation: 你感到自己的时间正在耗尽。

messages.english: You are faintly shadowed, very rarely releasing foul flame when damaged in melee.
messages.translation: 你身上有淡淡阴影，近战受伤时极少释放邪焰。

messages.english: You are shadowed, sometimes releasing foul flame when damaged in melee.
messages.translation: 你身上有阴影，近战受伤时有时释放邪焰。

messages.english: You are darkly shadowed, frequently releasing foul flame when damaged in melee.
messages.translation: 你身上有浓重阴影，近战受伤时经常释放邪焰。

messages.english: Your body darkens with foul flame.
messages.translation: 你的身体因邪焰而变暗。

messages.english: Your body becomes darker with foul flame.
messages.translation: 你的身体因邪焰而进一步变暗。
你身体的黑暗完全消退了。

messages.english: You regain HP and MP as you explore.
messages.translation: 你会在探索时恢复生命值和魔力。
你觉得自己成了宅家的人。

messages.english: You gain doubled healing and magic from potions.
messages.translation: 你从药水获得的治疗和魔力加倍。

messages.english: You heal twice as much from potions.
messages.translation: 你从药水获得的治疗加倍了。

messages.english: You no longer heal twice as much from potions.
messages.translation: 你从药水获得的治疗不再加倍。

messages.english: Whenever you drink a healing potion, you attack all around you.
messages.translation: 每当你饮用治疗药水时，都会攻击周围的所有敌人。

messages.english: You brawl whenever you drink a healing potion.
messages.translation: 每当你饮用治疗药水时，都会发起乱斗。

messages.english: You no longer brawl whenever you drink a healing potion.
messages.translation: 你不再在饮用治疗药水时发起乱斗。

messages.english: You can use scrolls of enchantment on lesser artefacts.
messages.translation: 你能对低等神器使用附魔卷轴。

messages.english: You can now use scrolls of enchantment on lesser artefacts.
messages.translation: 你现在能对低等神器使用附魔卷轴了。

messages.english: You can no longer use scrolls of enchantment on lesser artefacts.
messages.translation: 你无法再对低等神器使用附魔卷轴。

messages.english: Your spellcasting is much less encumbered by armour.
messages.translation: 防具对你施法的妨碍大幅减少。

messages.english: Your spellcasting becomes less encumbered by armour.
messages.translation: 防具对你施法的妨碍减轻了。

messages.english: Your spellcasting no longer less encumbered by armour.
messages.translation: 防具对你施法的妨碍不再减轻。

messages.english: You can equip up to 6 pieces of aux armour in any combination.
messages.translation: 你能以任意组合装备最多6件辅助防具。

messages.english: You can equip up to 6 pieces of aux armour in any combination and unleash them.
messages.translation: 你能以任意组合装备最多6件辅助防具，并将它们释放出去。

messages.english: You feel ready to unleash a true cacophony.
messages.translation: 你感到自己已准备好释放真正的不谐狂响。

messages.english: You will be able to unleash your equipped armour.
messages.translation: 你将能够释放已装备的防具。

messages.english: You gain AC when you inflict magical misfortune on nearby enemies.
messages.translation: 对附近敌人施加魔法厄运时，你会获得护甲值。

messages.english: You can enhance your damage-dealing spells by burning harvested memories.
messages.translation: 你能燃烧收集的记忆，强化伤害法术。
你的火焰不再那么饥渴了。

messages.english: You will be able to burn memories to enhance your damage-dealing spells.
messages.translation: 你将能够燃烧记忆来强化伤害法术。

messages.english: You perform a melee attack whenever you cast damage-dealing spells.
messages.translation: 每当你施放伤害法术时，都会发起一次近战攻击。

messages.english: You feel destructive magic coursing through your claws.
messages.translation: 你感到毁灭魔法在利爪中流淌。

messages.english: You no longer feel destructive magic coursing through your claws.
messages.translation: 你不再感到毁灭魔法在利爪中流淌。

messages.english: You recover more slowly from Doom and Banes.
messages.translation: 你从厄运和厄咒中恢复得更慢。

messages.english: Your shed blood may rise up to attack you.
messages.translation: 你洒落的鲜血可能站起来攻击你。

messages.english: Your shed blood may rise up to attack you as a group.
messages.translation: 你洒落的鲜血可能成群站起来攻击你。

messages.english: You feel a willful anger gathering in your blood.
messages.translation: 你感到鲜血中聚起了顽固的怒火。

messages.english: You feel your blood grow even more spiteful.
messages.translation: 你感到鲜血变得更加怨毒。
你的鲜血再次平静了下来。

messages.english: Your blood feels a little less spiteful.
messages.translation: 你的鲜血似乎不那么怨毒了。

messages.english: You draw destruction from the endless fires of Gehenna.
messages.translation: 你从欣嫩谷无尽的烈焰中汲取毁灭之力。

messages.english: You feel your soul grow hot with the fiery destruction of Gehenna.
messages.translation: 欣嫩谷炽热的毁灭使你的灵魂变得灼热。

messages.english: You draw destruction from the frigid wastes of Cocytus.
messages.translation: 你从悲叹河冰冷的荒原中汲取毁灭之力。

messages.english: You feel your soul grow cold with the frigid destruction of Cocytus.
messages.translation: 悲叹河冰寒的毁灭使你的灵魂变得寒冷。

messages.english: You draw destruction from the wailing grief of Tartarus.
messages.translation: 你从塔尔塔罗斯哀嚎的悲恸中汲取毁灭之力。

messages.english: You feel your soul grow tainted with the deathly destruction of Tartarus.
messages.translation: 塔尔塔罗斯死亡的毁灭使你的灵魂受到污染。

messages.english: You draw destruction from the ruthless spite of Dis.
messages.translation: 你从冥府冷酷的怨毒中汲取毁灭之力。

messages.english: You feel your soul grow bitter with the corrosive destruction of Dis.
messages.translation: 冥府腐蚀的毁灭使你的灵魂变得苦涩。

messages.english: You bear the Mark of Haemoclasm.
Gore shall rain upon your enemies.
messages.translation: 血肉将如雨般洒向你的敌人。

messages.english: You bear the Mark of the Legion.
The armies of chaos are now yours to lead.
messages.translation: 混沌军队现在任你指挥。

messages.english: You bear the Mark of Carnage.
Your servants grow eager to unleash destruction.
messages.translation: 你的仆从迫切地渴望释放毁灭之力。

messages.english: You bear the Mark of Annihilation.
You feel the destructive energies within you surge violently.
messages.translation: 你感到体内的毁灭能量猛烈激增。

messages.english: You bear the Mark of the Tyrant.
Even fiends shall kneel before you now.
messages.translation: 现在连魔王也将跪伏在你面前。

messages.english: You bear the Mark of the Celebrant.
Your suffering will be repaid in blood.
messages.translation: 你的苦难将得到血的回报。

messages.english: You bear the Mark of Execution.
Murder takes root in your soul.
messages.translation: 杀戮在你的灵魂中扎根。

messages.english: You bear the Mark of Atrocity.
You will scour this world clean.
messages.translation: 你将把这个世界洗涤干净。

messages.english: You bear the Mark of the Fanatic.
You will become an instrument of Makhleb's will.
messages.translation: 你将成为马科列布意志的工具。

messages.english: Large bone plates grow over parts of your %s.
messages.translation: 大块骨板长在了你%s的部分部位。

messages.english: Large bone plates spread over more of your %s.

The bolas wraps around you and binds you in place!
messages.translation: 流星索缠住你，将你束缚在原地！

Your body starts to freeze solid!
Your atemporal blood churns to no real effect.

messages.translation: 涌出的时间扭曲之血使盟友获得疾速！

messages.english: A shower of butterflies erupts from you!

messages.english: You emit a cloud of colourful smoke!
messages.translation: 你释放出一团彩色烟雾！

messages.english: Angry insects swarm out of your body to defend their hive!
messages.translation: 愤怒的昆虫从你体内涌出，保卫它们的巢穴！

messages.english: Your pain echoes through the poison around you!
messages.translation: 你的痛苦在周围的毒素中回荡！

messages.english: Your spilled blood starts moving with violent intent!
messages.translation: 你流出的鲜血开始怀着暴虐的意图蠕动！

messages.translation: 死亡之际，你的身体扭曲变形。

messages.english: Your body crumbles into a pile of gold.
messages.translation: 你的身体崩解成一堆金币。

messages.english: %s scurries out from under your cloak.
You shudder from the %s and a %s!
flood of jellies pours out from you
messages.translation: 大量胶怪从你身上涌出
一只胶怪从你身上冒出

messages.english: %s appreciates %s killing of a heretic priest.

messages.translation: 佐特宝珠迸发出狂怒的光芒！

messages.translation: 魔窟的领主们很不高兴。小心！

messages.translation: 佐特宝珠尖啸着，化作抗拒你魔法的沉重死物！

messages.english: The Orb lets out a furious burst of light and becomes a dead weight against your magic!
messages.translation: 佐特宝珠迸发出狂怒的光芒，化作抗拒你魔法的沉重死物！

messages.english: The Orb shrieks as your magic touches it!
messages.translation: 你的魔法触及佐特宝珠时，它尖啸起来！

messages.translation: 你的魔法触及佐特宝珠时，它迸发出狂怒的光芒！

messages.english: Now pick up the Orb and get out of here!
messages.translation: 现在拿起佐特宝珠，离开这里！

messages.english: There were no monsters in sight!
There are no monsters in sight!

messages.translation: 你那具有腐蚀性的神器

messages.english: Your unstable footing causes you to fumble your attack.
messages.translation: 立足不稳让你未能顺利发起攻击。

messages.translation: 你陷入狂暴，眼前仿佛蒙上了一层血色！
你的精湛技艺骤然结束。
你感觉自己的动作变快了！

messages.english: You feel a build-up of mutagenic energy.
messages.translation: 你感觉诱变能量正在积聚。

messages.english: You feel a malign power afflict you.
messages.translation: 你感觉一股恶意的力量侵袭了你。

messages.english: You feel ready to rampage towards enemies.
messages.translation: 你感觉已准备好向敌人横冲直撞。

messages.english: You feel strangely lacking in power.
messages.translation: 你感觉莫名地缺乏力量。

messages.translation: 诱变能量涌入你的体内！

messages.english: You no longer feel able to rampage towards enemies.
messages.translation: 你不再觉得自己能向敌人横冲直撞。

messages.english: You really shouldn't be using a holy item like this.
messages.translation: 你实在不该使用这样的神圣物品。

messages.english: You really shouldn't be using an evil item like this.
messages.translation: 你实在不该使用这样的邪恶物品。

messages.english: You really shouldn't be using an unclean item like this.
messages.translation: 你实在不该使用这样的不洁物品。

messages.english: You really shouldn't be using a chaotic item like this.
messages.translation: 你实在不该使用这样的混沌物品。

messages.english: You really shouldn't be using a hasty item like this.
messages.translation: 你实在不该使用这样的加速物品。

messages.english: You really shouldn't be using a wizardly item like this.
messages.translation: 你实在不该使用这样的施法辅助物品。

messages.english: You hear the crackle of electricity.

messages.translation: 你感受到一股不洁的气息。

messages.english: You feel a sense of dread.
You have a feeling of ineptitude.
You feel a force failing to suppress your magic.
messages.translation: 你感觉有股力量试图压制你的魔法，却未能奏效。

messages.english: Space warps around you for a moment!
messages.translation: 你周围的空间短暂地扭曲了！
你的武器闪烁着跃跃欲试的光芒。
你感受到一种恶毒的狡黠。

messages.english: You feel the dreadful sensation subside.
You feel magic returning to you.
You feel your power drawn to a protective spirit.
messages.translation: 你感觉自己的力量被引向一位守护灵。

messages.english: Now linked to your health, your magic stops regenerating.
messages.translation: 你的魔力与生命相连，不再自行恢复。

messages.english: You feel the presence of a powerless spirit.
messages.translation: 你感觉到一位无力的灵体在场。

messages.english: You feel spirits watching over you.
messages.translation: 你感觉有灵体守护着你。

messages.english: You become transparent for a moment.
messages.translation: 你的身体短暂地变得透明。

messages.english: You feel resistant to extremes of temperature.
messages.translation: 你感觉能够抵抗酷热与严寒。

messages.english: You feel more protected from negative energy.
messages.translation: 你感觉对负能量的抵抗增强了。

messages.english: You feel that your aim is more steady.
messages.translation: 你感觉瞄准更加稳定了。

messages.english: You are surrounded by a repulsion field.

messages.translation: 你感觉对火焰的抵抗减弱了。

messages.english: You feel less resistant to cold.
messages.translation: 你感觉对寒冷的抵抗减弱了。

messages.english: You no longer feel resistant to poison.
messages.translation: 你不再感觉能够抵抗毒素。
你感觉感知不再那么敏锐。
你感觉意志不再那么坚定。
你感觉行动不再那么隐秘。

messages.english: You feel hot and cold all over.
You feel less protected from negative energy.
messages.translation: 你感觉对负能量的抵抗减弱了。

messages.english: Your magic begins regenerating once more.
messages.translation: 你的魔力再次开始自行恢复。

messages.english: Your aim is not that steady anymore.
messages.translation: 你的瞄准不再那么稳定了。

messages.english: The haze of the repulsion field disappears.
messages.translation: 偏斥力场的薄雾消散了。

messages.english: The dungeon's light returns to normal.
messages.translation: 地牢的光线恢复了正常。

messages.english: You feel a shielding aura gather around you.
messages.translation: 你感觉一道护盾光环在周围凝聚。

messages.english: You repel a surge of foreign magic.
messages.translation: 你抵御了一股外来的魔法。

messages.english: You feel a surge of self-confidence.
You already have all the faith you need.

messages.translation: 你感觉自己并未比平时更加灵活。

messages.english: You feel ready to tumble and roll out of harm's way.
messages.translation: 你感觉已准备好翻滚腾挪，避开伤害。

messages.english: You feel a deeper understanding of alchemy.
messages.translation: 你感觉对炼金术的理解更深了。

messages.translation: 你感觉自己的不适将更快消退。

messages.translation: 你感觉对怪物的吸引力减弱了。

messages.english: The heat melts your icy armour.
Monsters! Monsters everywhere! You have to get out of here!
messages.translation: 怪物！到处都是怪物！你必须逃离这里！

messages.english: You reel with horror at the sight of these foes!
messages.translation: 看到这些敌人，你惊恐得摇摇欲坠！

messages.english: You feel a twist of horror at the sight of this foe.
messages.translation: 看到这个敌人，你心中一阵恐惧。

messages.english: The roots around you sink back into the ground.
messages.translation: 缠绕你的根须缩回了地下。

messages.english: The zombie hands holding you return to the earth.
messages.translation: 抓住你的僵尸之手缩回了地下。

messages.english: Your orb has finished recharging its magic.
messages.translation: 你的宝珠已完成魔力充能。

messages.english: You feel your existence waver again.
messages.translation: 你感觉自身的存在再次动摇。
你的堡垒冲击消散了，未造成任何伤害。
你的肺部因缺氧而不堪重负。

messages.english: As the last of your armour is driven back to you, your cacophony ends.
messages.translation: 最后一片防具飞回你身边，不谐狂响随之结束。

messages.english: You are ready to perform a blood rite again.

messages.translation: 你的时间扭曲之血又能泛起涟漪了。

messages.english: The buzzing within you returns to its normal rhythm.
messages.translation: 你体内的嗡鸣恢复了正常节奏。

messages.translation: 受折磨的灵魂发出的哀号充斥着空气！

messages.translation: 你的基础属性为力量 %d、智力 %d、敏捷 %d。

messages.english: The curse of the Prune overcomes you.
messages.translation: 普鲁恩的诅咒压倒了你。

messages.english: You cannot enter water in your current form.
messages.translation: 你当前的形态无法进入水中。

messages.english: It's unwise to walk into this.
Moving in this stuff is going to be slow.
Don't expect to remain undetected while in the water.
messages.translation: 在水中时，别指望不被发现。

messages.english: Acid dripping from the walls corrodes you.
messages.translation: 墙上滴落的酸液腐蚀了你。

messages.english: You feel power welling in your lungs.
messages.translation: 你感觉力量在肺中积聚。

messages.english: You feel ready to make another cacophony.
messages.translation: 你感觉又能施展不谐狂响了。

messages.english: You feel ready to scatter into bats once more.
messages.translation: 你感觉又能化作蝙蝠四散飞去了。

messages.english: You feel ready to drown your foes once more.
messages.translation: 你感觉又能淹没敌人了。

messages.translation: 你感觉周围的厄运消散了。

messages.translation: 你能掌握的法术已满，失去了较早获得的一个法术。

messages.english: You have reached level 27, the final one!
messages.translation: 你已达到最终等级：27 级！

messages.english: You have reached level %d, the highest you will ever reach!
messages.translation: 你已达到 %d 级，再也无法提升等级了！

你的恶魔血统开始显现……

messages.english: You feel a burst of inspiration! You are finally ready to make a one-of-a-kind gizmo!
messages.translation: 你灵光乍现！你终于准备好制造一件独一无二的装置了！

messages.english: You are illuminated by a large divine halo.
messages.translation: 一道巨大的神圣光环照亮了你。

messages.translation: 一道神圣光环照亮了你。

messages.english: You are illuminated by a small divine halo.

messages.translation: 你在生理上已死亡，无法支付生命。

messages.translation: 你的魔法污染已降至安全水平。

messages.translation: 魔法污染的光芒已经消失，你现在完全隐形了。

messages.english: Your magical contamination has completely faded away.
messages.translation: 你的魔法污染已经完全消退。

messages.english: Your divine stamina protects you from confusion!
messages.translation: 你的神圣耐力保护你免于混乱！

messages.english: Your divine stamina protects you from poison!
messages.translation: 你的神圣耐力保护你免于中毒！

messages.english: Your divine stamina protects you from the miasma!
messages.translation: 你的神圣耐力保护你免受瘴气侵害！

messages.english: You dip into the water, and the flames go out!
messages.translation: 你浸入水中，火焰熄灭了！

messages.english: The liquid fire finally exhausts itself.
You shake off the liquid fire.
You shake off some of the fire as you move.
messages.translation: 你移动时甩掉了一些火焰。

messages.english: You feel your silence will last longer.
messages.translation: 你感觉沉默将持续更久。
一片异常的寂静笼罩了你。

messages.english: Your stasis prevents you from being slowed.
You already are as slow as you could be.
messages.translation: 你的速度已经无法再慢了。
你感觉自己的动作变慢了。

messages.english: You feel as though you will be slow longer.
messages.translation: 你感觉减速将持续更久。
你感觉自己的动作变快了。

messages.english: Barbed spikes become lodged in your body.
messages.translation: 带倒刺的尖刺扎进了你的身体。

messages.english: You are blinded for an even longer time.
You recover from your berserk rage.
Your stasis prevents you from being hasted.
You already have as much speed as you can handle.
messages.translation: 你的速度已经达到所能承受的极限。

messages.english: You feel as though your hastened speed will last longer.
messages.translation: 你感觉疾速将持续更久。

messages.english: Your extra speed is starting to run out.
messages.translation: 你的额外速度开始消退。

messages.english: Your tail turns into legs as you fly out of the water.
messages.translation: 你飞离水面，尾巴变回了双腿。

messages.english: You swoop lightly up into the air.
You fly up into the air.
You resist the pull of the Abyss.
Your stasis prevents you from being paralysed.
You shrug off the repeated attempt to disable you.
messages.translation: 你抵御了再次使你失去行动能力的企图。

messages.english: You suddenly lose the ability to move!
Your divine stamina protects you from petrification!
messages.translation: 你的神圣耐力保护你免于石化！

messages.english: Your clarity of mind shields you.
Your divine stamina protects you from disease!
messages.translation: 你的神圣耐力保护你免于疾病！
你感觉自己莫名地显眼。

messages.english: You shrug off repeated attempt to disable you.
messages.translation: 你抵御了再次使你失去行动能力的企图。

messages.english: You can't fall asleep in your current state!
messages.translation: 你当前的状态无法入睡！

messages.english: You snap out of your daze.

messages.translation: 你的掘地本能让你免于坠入竖井！

messages.english: Yredelemnul refuses to let your conquest be stopped by a trick of the earth!
messages.translation: 伊莱德莱姆努尔不容许大地的诡计阻止你的征服！

messages.english: You can't shaft yourself in your current form.
messages.translation: 你当前的形态无法自行挖掘竖井。

messages.english: You can't shaft yourself while unable to move.
messages.translation: 无法移动时，你不能自行挖掘竖井。

messages.translation: 你无法在这一层自行挖掘竖井。

messages.translation: 你无法在这种地形上自行挖掘竖井。
一道竖井出现在你的脚下！

messages.english: The mark upon you grows brighter.
messages.translation: 你身上的标记变得更亮了。

messages.english: A sentinel's mark forms upon you.
messages.translation: 一道哨卫标记出现在你身上。

messages.english: You feel your attacks grow feeble.
You feel as though you will be weak longer.
messages.translation: 你感觉虚弱将持续更久。

messages.english: You feel your spells grow feeble.
You feel as though your spells will be weakened for longer.
messages.translation: 你感觉法术削弱将持续更久。

messages.english: You feel your power leaking away.

messages.translation: 你的身体变得如玻璃般脆弱！

messages.english: You feel your fragility will last longer.
messages.translation: 你感觉脆弱将持续更久。

messages.translation: 你的身体排斥了部分治疗。

你的血液凝结成凝血护甲。

messages.english: Your weapon exudes an aura of protection.
messages.translation: 你的武器散发出保护光环。

messages.english: You feel bolstered by spreading misfortune.

messages.translation: 你感觉魔法能量造成的污染略微减轻了。

messages.english: Trog will now gift you melee weapons as you gain piety.
messages.translation: 特洛戈现在会在你的虔诚提升时赐予你近战武器。

messages.english: Trog will no longer gift you weapons.
messages.translation: 特洛戈不再赐予你武器。

messages.english: Trog will gift you melee weapons as you gain piety.
messages.translation: 随着你的虔诚增长，特洛戈会赐予你近战武器。

messages.english: Nemelex will now gift you decks of power as you gain piety.
messages.translation: 尼姆雷斯现在会在你的虔诚提升时赐予你力量牌组。

messages.english: Nemelex will no longer gift you decks.
messages.translation: 尼姆雷斯不再赐予你牌组。

messages.english: Nemelex will gift you decks of power as you gain piety.
messages.translation: 随着你的虔诚增长，尼姆雷斯・索布会赐予你力量牌组。

messages.english: Lugonu protects you from the effects of unwielding distortion weapons.
messages.translation: 卢戈努保护你免受放下扭曲武器的影响。

messages.english: Lugonu may banish nearby foes when other gods try to punish you.
messages.translation: 其他神祇试图惩罚你时，卢戈努可能放逐附近的敌人。

messages.english: Lugonu will corrupt your weapon with distortion... once.
messages.translation: 卢戈努将以扭曲之力腐化你的武器……仅此一次。

messages.english: Lugonu is no longer ready to corrupt your weapon.
messages.translation: 卢戈努不再准备腐化你的武器。

messages.english: Beogh will now send orc apostles to challenge you in battle as you gain piety.
messages.translation: 比欧弗现在会在你的虔诚提升时派遣兽人使徒向你挑战。

messages.english: Beogh will no longer send orc apostles to challenge you in battle.
messages.translation: 比欧弗不再派遣兽人使徒向你挑战。

messages.english: Beogh will send orc apostles to challenge you in battle as you gain piety.
messages.translation: 随着你的虔诚增长，比欧弗会派遣兽人使徒前来挑战你。

messages.english: You can recruit apostles that you defeat into your service.
messages.translation: 你可以招募被你击败的使徒为你效力。

messages.english: Your apostles are sometimes healed when you deal damage.
messages.translation: 当你造成伤害时，你的使徒有时会得到治疗。

messages.english: Jiyva is now protecting you from corrosive effects.
messages.translation: 吉瓦现在会保护你免受腐蚀效果的影响。

messages.english: Jiyva will no longer protect you from corrosive effects.
messages.translation: 吉瓦不再保护你免受腐蚀效果的影响。

messages.english: Jiyva protects you from corrosive effects.
messages.translation: 吉瓦保护你免受腐蚀效果影响。

messages.english: Jiyva will now mutate your body as you gain piety.
messages.translation: 吉瓦现在会在你的虔诚提升时改变你的身体变异。

messages.english: Jiyva will no longer mutate your body.
messages.translation: 吉瓦不再改变你的身体变异。

messages.english: Jiyva will mutate your body as you gain piety.
messages.translation: 随着你的虔诚增长，吉瓦会使你的身体发生变异。

messages.english: You may now expel jellies when seriously injured.
messages.translation: 你现在可能在重伤时排出胶怪。

messages.english: You will no longer expel jellies when injured.
messages.translation: 你不再在受伤时排出胶怪。

messages.english: You may expel jellies when seriously injured.
messages.translation: 你受到重伤时可能释放出软泥怪。

messages.english: You can walk through plants and fire through allied plants.
messages.translation: 你可以穿过植物，并让攻击穿过友方植物。

messages.english: Cheibriados is now slowing the effects of poison on you.
messages.translation: 切布理亚多现在会减缓毒素对你的影响。

messages.english: Cheibriados will no longer slow the effects of poison on you.
messages.translation: 切布理亚多不再减缓毒素对你的影响。

messages.english: Cheibriados slows the effects of poison on you.
messages.translation: 切布理亚多延缓毒素对你的作用。

messages.english:
Ashenzari warns you of distant threats and treasures.
Ashenzari shows you where magical portals lie.
messages.translation:
艾申扎利会警告你远处的威胁与宝藏。
艾申扎利会指示魔法传送门的位置。

messages.english: Ashenzari will now identify your possessions.
messages.translation: 艾申扎利现在会鉴定你的物品。

messages.english: Ashenzari will no longer identify your possesions.
messages.translation: 艾申扎利不再鉴定你的物品。
艾申扎利鉴定你拥有的物品。

messages.english: Ashenzari will now reveal the unseen.
messages.translation: 艾申扎利现在会揭示隐形之物。

messages.english: Ashenzari will no longer reveal the unseen.
messages.translation: 艾申扎利不再揭示隐形之物。
艾申扎利揭示不可见的事物。

messages.english: Ashenzari will now keep your mind clear.
messages.translation: 艾申扎利现在会保持你的头脑清明。

messages.english: Ashenzari will no longer keep your mind clear.
messages.translation: 艾申扎利不再保持你的头脑清明。
艾申扎利使你的心智保持清明。

messages.english: Ashenzari will now protect you from the dungeon's malevolent forces.
messages.translation: 艾申扎利现在会保护你免受地下城中恶意力量的影响。

messages.english: Ashenzari no longer protects you from the dungeon's malevolent forces.
messages.translation: 艾申扎利不再保护你免受地下城中恶意力量的影响。

messages.english: Ashenzari protects you from the dungeon's malevolent forces.
messages.translation: 艾申扎利保护你免受地下城中恶意力量的侵扰。

messages.english: Ashenzari reveals the structure of the nearby dungeon.
messages.translation: 艾申扎利揭示附近地下城的结构。

messages.english: Ashenzari no longer reveals the structure of the nearby dungeon.
messages.translation: 艾申扎利不再揭示附近地下城的结构。

messages.english: Dithmenos quiets all noise in your surroundings.
messages.translation: 迪斯姆诺使你周围的一切声音安静下来。

messages.english: Dithmenos no longer quiets all noise in your surroundings.
messages.translation: 迪斯姆诺不再消除你周围的所有噪音。

messages.english: Your shadow now sometimes tangibly mimics your actions.
messages.translation: 你的影子现在偶尔会以实体模仿你的行动。

messages.english: Your shadow no longer tangibly mimics your actions.
messages.translation: 你的影子不再以实体模仿你的行动。

messages.english: Your shadow sometimes tangibly mimics your actions.
messages.translation: 你的影子有时会化为实体，模仿你的行动。

messages.english: Gozag turns your defeated foes' bodies to gold.
messages.translation: 哥萨戈将被你击败的敌人的尸体化为黄金。

messages.english: Your enemies may become distracted by gold.
messages.translation: 你的敌人可能因黄金而分心。

messages.english: Qazlal grants you and your divine allies immunity to clouds.
messages.translation: 卡兹拉尔使你与你的神授盟友免疫云雾。

messages.english: You are now surrounded by a storm.
You are surrounded by a storm.
The storm surrounding you is now powerful enough to repel missiles.
messages.translation: 你周围的风暴现在已足以排斥飞射物。

messages.english: The storm surrounding you is now too weak to repel missiles.
messages.translation: 你周围的风暴现在太弱，无法排斥飞射物。

messages.english: The storm surrounding you is powerful enough to repel missiles.
messages.translation: 环绕你的风暴足够强大，能够排斥飞射物。

messages.english: You will now adapt resistances upon receiving elemental damage.
messages.translation: 你现在会在受到元素伤害后获得相应抗性。

messages.english: You will no longer adapt resistances upon receiving elemental damage.
messages.translation: 你不再在受到元素伤害后获得相应抗性。

messages.english: You adapt resistances upon receiving elemental damage.
messages.translation: 受到元素伤害时，你会适应性地获得抗性。

messages.english: You now exude an aura of power that intimidates your foes.
messages.translation: 你散发出力量光环，威慑敌人。

messages.english: You no longer exude an aura of power that intimidates your foes.
messages.translation: 你不再散发震慑敌人的威势。

messages.english: Your aura of power can now strike those that harm you.
messages.translation: 你的威势现在可以反击伤害你的人。

messages.english: Your aura of power no longer strikes those that harm you.
messages.translation: 你的威势不再反击伤害你的人。

messages.english: Your aura of power can strike those that harm you.
messages.translation: 你的力量光环能够打击伤害你的生物。

messages.english: Uskayaw will force your foes to helplessly watch your dance.
messages.translation: 阿斯卡亚将迫使敌人无助地观看你的舞蹈。

messages.english: Uskayaw will no longer force your foes to helplessly watch your dance.
messages.translation: 阿斯卡亚不再强迫敌人无助地观看你的舞蹈。

messages.english: Uskayaw will force your foes to share their pain.
messages.translation: 阿斯卡亚将迫使敌人分担彼此的痛苦。

messages.english: Uskayaw will no longer force your foes to share their pain.
messages.translation: 阿斯卡亚不再强迫敌人分担痛苦。

messages.english: Your ancestor manifests to aid you.
messages.translation: 你的先祖显现并协助你。

messages.english: You now drain nearby creatures when transferring your ancestor.
messages.translation: 你现在会在转移先祖时吸取附近生物的能量。

messages.english: You no longer drain nearby creatures when transferring your ancestor.
messages.translation: 你不再在转移先祖时吸取附近生物的能量。

messages.english: You drain nearby creatures when transferring your ancestor.
messages.translation: 转移先祖时，你会吸取附近生物的生命。

messages.english: summon a storm of heavenly clouds
These spells will remain available as long as you worship Vehumet.
messages.translation: 只要你继续信奉维胡梅特，这些法术就会一直可用。

messages.english: %s remembers more of their old skill.

messages.translation: 愤怒的咕噜声从四面八方传来！

messages.english: "You will pay for your transgression, mortal!"
messages.translation: “凡人，你会为自己的罪行付出代价！”

messages.english: %s forms a fragment of your life essence into the memory of your ancestor, %s!
messages.translation: %s将你的一缕生命精华化作先祖%s的记忆！

messages.english: %s raises the support of your attributes.
%s raises the support of your attributes as your movement slows.
messages.translation: %s随着你的移动减缓，提升了对你属性的支持。

messages.english: %s lowers the support of your attributes.
%s lowers the support of your attributes as your movement quickens.
messages.translation: %s随着你的移动加快，降低了对你属性的支持。

messages.english: %s does not appreciate desertion for chaos!
messages.translation: %s对你投向混沌的背叛很不满！

messages.english: %s does not appreciate desertion for evil!
messages.translation: %s对你投向邪恶的背叛很不满！
<lightgrey>你的身体没有发光便消失了。</lightgrey>

messages.english: Your body glows slightly and disappears.
messages.translation: 你的身体微微发光，然后消失了。

messages.english: <white>Your body glows with a rainbow of weird colours and disappears.</white>
messages.translation: <white>你的身体闪耀着诡异的彩虹光芒，然后消失了。</white>
<lightgrey>你的身体没有变得更亮便消失了。</lightgrey>

messages.english: Your body glows slightly brighter and disappears.
messages.translation: 你的身体变得稍微更亮，然后消失了。

messages.english: Your access to %s's decks is revoked.
messages.translation: 你不能再使用%s的牌组了。

messages.english: %s removes the imprint of %s from your paragon.
Your %s burns with power once more.
%s goes dull and lifeless in your grasp.
messages.translation: 你手中的%s变得暗淡，失去了生气。

messages.english: %s glows horrifically with a foul blackness!
You pray at the altar of %s by %s.
Your evil deeds will not go unpunished
messages.translation: 你的恶行必将受到惩罚

messages.english: You will pay for your evil ways, mortal
messages.translation: 凡人，你会为自己的邪恶行径付出代价

messages.english: You will suffer for embracing such chaos
messages.translation: 你会为投向这种混沌而受苦

messages.english: You will suffer for embracing such evil
messages.translation: 你会为投向这种邪恶而受苦

messages.english: You will be buggily punished for this
messages.translation: 你会因此受到错误的惩罚
附在你身上的胶怪吃掉了%s！

messages.english: %s blocks the %s with their %s... and reflects it back!
messages.translation: %s挡下了%s，使用的是%s……并将其反射回来！

messages.english: %s blocks the %s with an invisible shield... and reflects it back!
messages.translation: %s用一面隐形盾牌挡下了%s……并将其反射回来！

messages.english: %s blocks the %s... and reflects it back!
This will place you under penance!
messages.translation: 这会使你受到赎罪惩罚！

messages.english: Memorise %s, consuming %s spell levels and leaving %s?%s
messages.translation: 记忆%s，消耗%s级法术容量，剩余%s级？%s

messages.english: You can access your shopping list by pressing '$'.
messages.translation: 按 '$' 可以打开购物清单。

messages.english: Your shopping list is now empty.
messages.translation: 你的购物清单现在空了。

messages.english: Orders for allies: a - Attack new target.
messages.translation: 盟友命令：a - 攻击新目标。
r - 撤退！        s - 停止攻击。

messages.english: g - Guard the area.      f - Follow me.
messages.translation: g - 守卫此地。    f - 跟随我。

messages.english: You're too berserk to give orders, and you can't shout!
messages.translation: 你正处于狂暴中，无法下达命令，也无法呼喊！

messages.english: You are unable to make a sound!
You cannot train any new skills!
messages.translation: 你无法训练任何新技能！

messages.english: You need to enable at least one skill for training.
messages.translation: 你需要至少启用一项技能进行训练。

messages.english: Your training target must be 27 or below!

messages.translation: 你已经学会那个法术了！

messages.english: Your mind is already too full of spells!
messages.translation: 你的头脑已经装不下更多法术了！

messages.english: You're too inexperienced to learn that spell!
messages.translation: 你的经验还不足以学习那个法术！

messages.english: You can't memorise that many levels of magic yet!
messages.translation: 你目前还无法记忆那么多级的法术！

messages.english: This spell is impossible to cast!
You don't know any spells that your servitor could cast!
messages.translation: 你没有学会仆从能施放的法术！

messages.english: Casting this spell will place you under penance. Really cast?
messages.translation: 施放这个法术会使你受到赎罪惩罚。确定要施放吗？

messages.english: It is impossible to cast this spell (100%% risk of failure)!
messages.translation: 这个法术无法施放（失败风险为 100%%）！

messages.english: You feel a surge of divine spite.
messages.translation: 你感到一阵神明的恶意。

messages.english: %s does not allow the disloyal to dabble in death!
%s does not allow the disloyal to dabble in destruction!
Casting this now could dangerously contaminate you. Continue?
messages.translation: 现在施放可能会使你受到危险的魔法污染。继续吗？

messages.english: You might harm nearby allies! Ignite poison anyway?
messages.translation: 你可能伤及附近的盟友！仍然施放燃毒术吗？

messages.english: You can't see anything there. Cast anyway?
messages.translation: 你看不到那里有什么。仍然施放吗？

messages.english: The unravelling is likely to hit you. Continue anyway?
messages.translation: 解构很可能会伤及你。仍然继续吗？

messages.english: Your magical effects refuse to unravel!
messages.translation: 你身上的魔法效果拒绝被解构！

messages.english: You are no longer on fire.

messages.translation: 你的堡垒冲击无害地消散了。
你身上的魔法效果正在被解构。

messages.english: Beogh will not strike down an ally of the cause.
messages.translation: 比欧弗不会杀害信奉祂的盟友。

messages.english: %s booms: This is a trial of mortal prowess. Fight with your own strength!
messages.translation: %s轰然喝道：这是凡人实力的试炼。凭你自己的力量战斗！

messages.english: You are blasted by holy energy!
%s is blasted by Zin's holy word!
You feel a surge of unholy energy.
messages.translation: 你感到一阵不洁的能量。

messages.english: Your body is wracked with pain!
Something is bathed in an unholy light!
messages.translation: 某个东西沐浴在不洁的光芒中！

messages.english: Your necklace shatters, unleashing a wave of protective dreams!
messages.translation: 你的项链碎裂了，释放出一阵守护之梦！

messages.english: %s protects you from your miscast necromantic spell!
messages.translation: %s保护你免受这次死灵法术失误的伤害！

messages.english: You radiate an aura of cold.
The sign of ruin forms upon you!
messages.translation: 毁灭征兆出现在你身上！

messages.english: %s booms: How dare you animate that foul thing!
messages.translation: %s轰然喝道：你竟敢活化那种污秽之物！

messages.english: %s has no space to call forth the wretched!
messages.translation: %s没有空间唤出可怜的濒死者！

messages.english: %s calls piteous wretches from the earth!
messages.translation: %s从地下唤出了可怜的濒死者！

messages.english: Please don't blink into the map border.
messages.translation: 请不要闪现到地图边界中。

messages.english: Please don't try to blink into monsters.
messages.translation: 请不要尝试闪现到怪物身体里。

messages.english: Even you can't go there right now. Sorry!
messages.translation: 即使是你，现在也不能去那里。抱歉！

messages.english: You cannot see any enemies that you can affect. Speak a word of chaos anyway?
messages.translation: 你看不到任何能影响的敌人。仍然说出混沌真言吗？

messages.english: A tree falls to the furious winds!
The freezing vortex lifts you up.
The world spins around you as you enter the gateway.
messages.translation: 你进入传送门时，周围的世界旋转起来。

messages.english: A mysterious force pulls you upwards.
messages.translation: 一股神秘力量将你向上拉去。

messages.english: The hatch slams shut behind you.
messages.translation: 活板门在你身后砰然关闭。

messages.english: You slide down the stairs, becoming coated in regenerative ooze.
messages.translation: 你滑下楼梯，身上裹满了能促进再生的胶质。

messages.english: You have passed through the Ziggurat. Zot will hunt you nevermore.
messages.translation: 你穿过了通天塔。佐特再也不会追猎你。

messages.english: There is nothing on the other side of the stone arch.
messages.translation: 石拱门的另一边什么也没有。

messages.english: This shop has been abandoned, nothing of value remains.
messages.translation: 这家商店已被遗弃，没留下任何有价值的东西。

messages.english: Heavy smoke blows from the lock!
With a soft hiss the gate opens wide!
messages.translation: 随着一声轻轻的嘶响，大门敞开了！

messages.english: The nature of this place prevents you from teleporting.
messages.translation: 此地的特性阻止你传送。

messages.english: You feel stable on this floor.
messages.translation: 你感到在这层楼中很稳定。

messages.english: %s's power protects you from the chaos of Hell!
messages.translation: %s的力量保护你免受地狱混沌的侵袭！

messages.english: You announce your regal presence to all who would look upon you.
messages.translation: 你向所有注视你的人宣告自己的威严。

messages.english: The shaft disappears in a puff of logic!
messages.translation: 竖井在一阵逻辑中消失了！

messages.english: Strange, the shaft seems to lead back to this level.
messages.translation: 奇怪，竖井似乎通回了这一层。

messages.english: The strain on the space-time continuum destroys the shaft!
messages.translation: 时空连续体的扭曲摧毁了竖井！

messages.english: With a burst of heat and light, you rocket upward!
messages.translation: 随着一阵炽热光芒，你猛冲而上！

messages.english: In a burst of heat and light, you rocket briefly upward... but you can't rise from here.
messages.translation: 你在炽热光芒中短暂冲起……但无法从这里升上去。

messages.english: Your cacophony subsides as you depart the area.
messages.translation: 随着你离开此地，不谐狂响平息了。

messages.english: Thank you for visiting Hell. Please come again soon.
messages.translation: 感谢光临地狱。欢迎再次到来。

messages.english: You plunge deeper into the Abyss.
The abyssal rune of Zot can be found at this depth.
messages.translation: 在这一深度可以找到深渊佐特符文。

messages.english: To return, you must find a gate leading back.
messages.translation: 你必须找到通往外界的门才能返回。

messages.english: Killing monsters will force the Abyss to allow you passage.
messages.translation: 击杀怪物将迫使深渊允许你通过。

messages.english: You pass into a different region of Pandemonium.
messages.translation: 你进入了魔窟的另一片区域。

messages.english: Zot already knows this place too well. Descend or flee this branch!
messages.translation: 佐特对这里已了如指掌。继续向下或逃离此分支！

messages.english: Zot's attention fixes on you again. Descend or flee this branch!
messages.translation: 佐特再次盯上了你。继续向下或逃离此分支！

messages.english: Zot has no power in the Abyss.
messages.translation: 佐特在深渊中没有力量。

messages.english: You feel Zot lose track of you.
messages.translation: 你感到佐特失去了你的踪迹。

messages.english: The door slams shut behind you.
Beware, you cannot shaft yourself on this level.
messages.translation: 注意，这一层无法自行制造竖井。

messages.english: Too many matches; use a more specific search.
